title: HEAD OF TECH TRANSFER & QC
description:
**Head of Tech Transfer \& Quality Control (QC)**
  

  

**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / CDMO / Sterile Manufacturing
  

**Position Level:** Senior Manager / Director / Department Head
  

**Location:** Castilla y León (Relocation support provided)
  

**Compensation:** Competitive package (€110,000 – €140,000 total compensation \+ relocation assistance)
  

  

**About the Company**
  

We are representing a leading European pharmaceutical business unit specializing in contract development, technology transfer, and commercial manufacturing for international clients. The company operates a state\-of\-the\-art facility focused on high\-complexity sterile products and is undergoing a phase of accelerated international growth.
  

  

**Position Summary**
  

The **Head of Tech Transfer \& QC** is a newly created, high\-visibility leadership position reporting directly to Executive Management. This role serves as the end\-to\-end owner of the technology transfer program and oversees Quality Control (QC) operations.
  

The primary objective of this role is to standardize and accelerate the technical onboarding of new client molecules—directly driving the time\-to\-market metric from contract execution to commercial supply.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  



* **Tech Transfer Standardization:** Design, implement, and standardize end\-to\-end technology transfer protocols across diverse client pipelines.
* **Gap Assessment \& Feasibility:** Perform detailed technical, regulatory, and capacity gap assessments for new molecules prior to transfer initiation.
* **Validation Management:** Oversee the design and execution of validation protocols at local manufacturing plants and client facilities.
* **Technical Incident Governance:** Lead the resolution of technical and quality incidents occurring during transfer projects, ensuring robust documentation and compliance.
* **QC Governance:** Govern Quality Control functions to ensure strict compliance with international regulatory standards, partnering with on\-site QC operational teams.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and structure a specialized team of Tech Transfer professionals.
* **Executive Reporting:** Track and report monthly progress metrics to Executive Leadership, focusing on transfer milestones and timeline optimization.
  

  

**Target Candidate Profile**  

  



* **Experience:** 10–15\+ years of experience in technical transfer and analytical transfer, ideally within multi\-client or CDMO environments.
* **Technical Expertise:** Demonstrated expertise in complex pharmaceutical formulations, specifically **sterile manufacturing** and/or **cytotoxic products**.
* **Leadership \& Client Management:** Proven track record leading technical teams and managing client\-facing relationships under strict commercial deadlines.
* **Quality \& Validation Mastery:** Strong background in validation protocols, regulatory compliance, and high\-pressure technical problem\-solving.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.
* **Languages:** Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for international client communication and regulatory documentation. Spanish is highly beneficial.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to relocate to the manufacturing site area (relocation package included) and travel periodically to client facilities.
  

  

**Key Competencies**  

  



* **Autonomy:** Ability to operate effectively at a senior leadership level with high self\-direction.
* **Speed to Market:** Strong commercial urgency balanced with strict technical accuracy.
* **Process Builder:** Capability to transform informal processes into structured, repeatable operational frameworks.
* **Executive Communication:** Excellent presentation and negotiation skills across internal leadership and external corporate partners.

  
**Summary**
-----------


* €110,000 – €140,000
* On\-site
* Permanent
* Castile and León, Spain

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Graitec Group:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

  

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption, integration, and lasting value for our customers.

  

Our 800 experts across 30\+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world\-class partnerships with our own cutting\-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

  

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

 **How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  

**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy  

**Learn more about the Graitec Group:** graitec\-group.com/graitec\-a\-global\-player


About the Team Hiring:

The Campaign Execution team is the operational engine of Graitec's Growth Marketing function. We translate marketing strategy into always\-on, measurable programs that generate pipeline and drive revenue across 13 countries. The team spans marketing automation, content, email execution, program operations, and global campaign delivery.

  

Graitec is 40 years old and moving faster than ever. We are transitioning from a leading Autodesk reseller into a global IP software company — and marketing is central to that transformation. We have brand presence, a large customer base, and a growing product portfolio. What we need now is the execution infrastructure to convert that into predictable, scalable pipeline.

  

This role exists because we are ready to move beyond campaigns. We run programs — launches, events, seasonal pushes — and we run them well. But we have not yet built the always\-on growth engine that compounds over time: the lifecycle programs that never stop nurturing, the automation plays that respond to buyer signals in real time, and the performance loop that tells us what to scale and what to cut. That is what this Director helps build.


Overview:
* The Marketing Director (Global Campaign Execution) builds and leads the global marketing execution engine that converts audience engagement into qualified pipeline — evolving Graitec from discrete campaigns to always\-on, AI\-enabled growth programs that compound over time.
* Reporting to the VP, Global Growth Marketing, the Director leads a team of five and partners across Growth Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Solutions Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Revenue Operations. The VP sets strategy and organizational direction; this role owns the always\-on execution engine and is accountable for its pipeline contribution.

 **Always\-On Growth Engine:**

* In partnership with the VP, help drive the transition from building campaigns from scratch each quarter to running programs that are always on — spending team time improving what works rather than restarting from zero.
* Design and build full\-funnel lifecycle programs — acquisition, activation, expansion, retention — that run continuously and compound over time.
* Manage the operating model within the strategic direction set by the VP — campaign frameworks, channel mix execution, audience segmentation, and the feedback loops that drive optimization  

Use AI tools to accelerate personalization, content generation, campaign testing, and performance analysis at scale.

 **Campaign Orchestration \& Pipeline Acceleration:**

* Execute against campaign strategy set by the VP and Corporate and Solutions Marketing — translating strategy into activated, multi\-channel programs.
* Drive the campaign calendar, production timelines, and cross\-functional coordination across Growth Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
* Lead pipeline acceleration programs — ABM plays, nurture sequences, and SDR\-aligned follow\-up strategies — that move opportunities through the funnel.
* Identify the highest\-performing campaign motions, build the case to scale them, and present recommendations to the VP for approval.

 **Marketing Automation, Data \& Technology:**

* Own the global marketing automation platform as a revenue system — not a broadcast tool — ensuring it operates with precision, segmentation, and measurable impact.
* Drive lead scoring, routing logic, nurture architecture, and CRM data quality in close collaboration with Revenue Operations.
* Implement the first\-party data strategy set by the VP — enabling signal\-based, personalized marketing at scale.
* Evaluate and recommend AI\-powered marketing tools that improve targeting accuracy, content relevance, and campaign efficiency.

 **Performance Reporting \& Revenue Visibility:**

* Own marketing's performance narrative — pipeline attribution, campaign ROI, funnel conversion, and lifecycle metrics — reported to the VP and broader leadership on a regular cadence.
* Build the dashboards and data infrastructure that give leadership real\-time visibility into marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Drive a culture of measurement, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making across the team.

 **Partner \& Co\-Marketing Programs:**

* Lead Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing strategy and execution — moving from compliance reporting to strategic pipeline generation.
* Develop co\-marketing campaigns that integrate with the broader campaign calendar and are measured against pipeline contribution.

 **Team Leadership \& Organizational Development:**

* Lead, develop, and elevate a team of five — setting high standards for execution quality, accountability, and strategic contribution.
* Build a team culture where feedback loops are fast, testing is the norm, and performance is visible and celebrated.
* Develop each team member's capability over time, moving the team from executors to strategic contributors.

 **The Team:**

  

You will lead five direct reports spanning automation, content, program operations, and campaign execution:

* **Campaign Marketing Manager** — Global campaign execution, Italian market, Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing.
* **Marketing Automation Manager** — Global automation platform, nurture architecture, lead scoring and routing.
* **Content Specialist** — Blog publishing, web content, editorial calendar execution.
* **Marketing Programs Manager** — Campaign operations, project management, product line and regional activation.
* **Email Execution Specialist** — Campaign build and deployment, platform operations, list management.

  

This is an execution\-strong team with room to grow strategically. Your job is to raise the ceiling.

 **Key Partners:**

* **Corporate Marketing** — Campaign strategy, core content, brand direction
* **Solutions Marketing** — Product positioning, messaging, GTM strategy
* **Digital Marketing** — SEO/GEO, paid media, analytics, web performance
* **Events \& Community** — Regional events, community programs, field activation
* **SDR Practice** — Lead qualification, pipeline acceleration, outbound plays
* **Sales** — Pipeline alignment, deal acceleration, win/loss insight
* **Revenue Operations** — Attribution, data governance, pipeline definitions, reporting

 **Business Purpose \& Value Contribution:**

  

Graitec is at an inflection point. In the last four years we doubled in size. In the next few years, we intend to do it again — this time driven by our own software, not just the products we resell. This Director role sits at the center of that ambition: if marketing gets this right, pipeline becomes predictable, sales cycles shorten, and the brand shifts in the market.

  

The role converts marketing strategy into revenue outcomes. It is accountable for the infrastructure — programs, automation, data, and reporting — that makes marketing's contribution to pipeline visible, repeatable, and scalable across all 13 countries.

  

You will work in a flat, entrepreneurial environment where leaders have real ownership — not a committee for every decision. You will have access to a team ready to grow, a VP who thinks strategically and removes obstacles, and a transformation story that is genuinely compelling in the market.

 **Key Outcomes Expected:**

  

Performance is reviewed quarterly against pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign effectiveness, and the team's progression toward an always\-on operating model. Annual targets are set in partnership with the VP, Global Growth Marketing and Revenue Operations.

 **Pipeline \& Revenue:**

* Marketing\-sourced pipeline ($ and %)
* Marketing\-influenced pipeline
* MQL to SQL to Opportunity conversion rates
* Pipeline velocity

 **Campaign Performance:**

* Pipeline generated per campaign
* Campaign ROI and cost per opportunity
* Engagement rates by channel
* Channel efficiency benchmarks

 **Lifecycle \& Retention:**

* Nurture\-to\-opportunity rate
* Time\-to\-conversion by stage
* Lead recycling effectiveness
* Churn influence via retention plays

 **Operational Excellence:**

* Campaign launch consistency
* Attribution model accuracy
* Automation platform adoption
* Data quality and database health

 **What Success looks like at 12 Months:**

* The team is running always\-on programs — key lifecycle and demand programs are live, being optimized continuously, and not rebuilt from scratch each quarter.
* Marketing has a clear, trusted pipeline attribution model — leadership and Sales agree on the numbers, and they are reported in real time.
* The Campaign Execution team is viewed as a strategic pipeline partner by Sales and SDR — not a service function that produces assets.
* AI tools are embedded in how the team works — accelerating personalization, content, testing, and reporting.
* Each team member has a clear development path and is operating at or above the expectations set for their role.
* Autodesk co\-marketing is generating measurable pipeline contribution, not just MDF compliance.


Responsibilities:
* 8–12 years in B2B marketing, with a majority of that time in demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution leadership.
* Demonstrated experience building always\-on marketing programs — lifecycle nurture, ABM, automated demand gen — that were measured against pipeline, not activity.
* Hands\-on proficiency with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot strongly preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
* Proven change management experience — you have led a team or function through a meaningful operational transformation, not just inherited a working model.
* Experience working in B2B SaaS or subscription software — you understand recurring revenue, expansion motion, and the full customer lifecycle.
* AI fluency — you use AI tools actively in your marketing practice and have a point of view on how they change what's possible for a team like this.
* Strong data and analytics capability — you can build attribution models, interpret funnel data, and communicate revenue impact to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of global or multi\-region marketing leadership.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

 **Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in AEC, construction tech, engineering software, or a technical B2B vertical with long sales cycles.
* Familiarity with Autodesk partner co\-marketing programs (MDF/MDP).
* Revenue Operations alignment experience — working alongside RevOps on shared pipeline definitions, data governance, and reporting.
* Experience with intent data platforms, CDPs, or signal\-based marketing orchestration.

 **How You Lead:**

* You are a builder, not a maintainer — you see the gap between where things are and where they should be, and you close it.
* You lead with data and communicate with executive clarity — metrics tell you what to do, but you decide how to frame it for the room.
* You raise the floor on execution quality while raising the ceiling on strategic ambition.
* You operate at the intersection of strategy and operations without losing altitude on either end.
* You build trust quickly with peers in Sales, SDR, Solutions Marketing, and Corporate Marketing — you influence without authority as often as you direct.


Interview Process:

At Graitec, we’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace.

  

We value our employees for who they are and the contributions they bring, encouraging everyone to be their authentic selves at work. This diversity helps us better serve the wide range of customers and markets we operate in. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and assess candidates solely on their skills and ability to succeed in the role.

  

Graitec uses AI to support and streamline internal processes; however, all application reviews, screening, and hiring decisions are made solely by our Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers.

* **Application** – Submit your CV and application via Graitec Careers.
* **HR Screening** – An initial “get to know you” discussion.
* **Hiring Manager Interview** – Role\-specific discussion with the manager.
* **Peer / Stakeholder Interview** – May include a presentation or collaborative exercise.
* **Final Interview** – Conversation with the Business Unit Leader

  

As a signatory of United Nations Women’s Empowerment Principles, Graitec is committed to equal opportunity and pay transparency.

  

On Target Earning pay range for this role:  

Role Targeted Variable Pay Mix: 30%  

Minimum Annual On Target Earning: 80K EUR  

Maximum Annual On Target Earning: 100K EUR

 **Note:** Salary range indicated in this add is for information only \& targeted for a specific seniority level and targeted location. Final salary offer might vary depending on final candidate location, seniority, competencies…

title: Strategy Manager
description:
**MGID** is a global advertising technology company and pioneer in native advertising, operating a programmatic platform that connects advertisers and publishers across 200\+ countries. The company runs a real\-time bidding (OpenRTB) business model with AI\-powered targeting and content recommendation widgets, serving hundreds of millions of users monthly.  

  

MGID is seeking a **Strategy Manager** to help define and execute the company’s multi\-year strategic direction, with a strong focus on shifting from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led mindset, evaluating strategic product and investment opportunities, and cascading strategy into prioritized, cross\-functional initiatives.


This role sits within a fast\-moving, data\-driven ad\-tech environment and reports to the COO.

 **Role Purpose**


The Strategy Manager will act as a key strategic partner to the COO and leadership team, responsible for shaping MGID’s medium\- to long\-term strategy, evaluating strategic options for products and markets, and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into concrete, prioritized projects with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

 **Who You Are:**

* 10\+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, or related roles within international tech scale\-ups or high\-growth environments; ad\-tech or programmatic advertising experience is a strong plus.
* Proven track record in a top\-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Big Four strategy practices) or equivalent strategic role in a tech company.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and presenting successful strategic cases with visible internal impact, such as new market entry, product portfolio optimization, or major investment decisions.
* Strong financial modeling skills, including practical experience with valuation methods such as DCF, NPV, and IRR, and the ability to build and maintain investment models in Excel.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, commercial, data/BI, and operations leaders in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior audiences and drive alignment across geographies.
* Self\-starter mindset: ready to operate as an individual contributor who can both design strategy and execute hands\-on.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Corporate \& Product Strategy**

* Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.
* Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.

title: Product Owner - Mainloop
location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
description:
**Product Owner**
=================


Own the product, not the ticket queue — the business relationship, the backlog, acceptance, and whether the thing actually gets used.


Mainloop is a **new engineering team inside an established international group**. We are in Barcelona, we are being built from scratch this year, and we have the backing, the customers and the product portfolio of a company that has been around for decades. You get the interesting part of a new team without the part where you check whether payroll clears.


Two more things about where this comes from and where it goes. **The group has been running a techlab in Casablanca for more than eight years** — Barcelona is its second, built to sit closer to the teams we build for, and AI\-native from the first commit, because it starts from a blank page. And the plan does not stop at internal work: **within about a year and a half we intend to externalise** — external clients, our products sold on the market, products developed for it. The first eighteen months are deliberately spent building as much as possible for the group while the machine gets set up. You would arrive at the start of that curve, not after it.


What we build is the software that automates professional\-services work — across roughly fifteen countries, for businesses drowning in administration: the forms, the approvals, the reconciliations, the spreadsheet somebody rebuilds every month. We work in two halves. One half goes into a business, finds out what really happens there, and proves fast whether an idea is worth having. **The other half — your half — takes what is proven and owns it for years: gathers the needs, keeps building, gets it adopted, and makes sure it stays worth having.** Most automation teams stop at the demo. The entire point of ours is that we do not.

**We are not looking for a backlog administrator.** If your last role was turning other people's decisions into tickets and running the ceremonies around them, this is a different job. Here you are the product manager *and* the product owner: there is no one above you writing the strategy for your products, and no one below you writing the stories. What should exist, in what order, and whether what shipped is right — that is yours.

##### **What the job actually is**


A product arrives with a handover pack — already proven with its stakeholders by the first half of the team, already hardened for production. From day one it belongs to you and one developer, as a pair, for its life.

* **You own the relationship with the business.** Real people, in real offices, whose working day your product either improves or does not. You go and sit with them. Not a ticket queue — trust, built in person, held over years.
* **You gather the needs and you decide.** Your users cannot churn — they are in the building, and they will bring you more requests than any team could build. Most of this job is choosing: what moves the outcome, what waits, and what you decline with a reason the person asking can respect. **Saying no well is the defining skill here**, and you will have a product vision to say it from.
* **You write what should exist, precisely.** In our team, coding agents build most of what ships, steered by your developer. Agents amplify whatever they are given: a sharp specification becomes working software astonishingly fast, and a vague one becomes a thousand lines of confidently wrong code. Your needs, rules, edge cases and acceptance criteria are the most load\-bearing documents in the company. Writing them precisely is the highest\-leverage hour of your week.
* **You accept, or you don't.** When something ships, you are the person who checks the behaviour against what you wrote — with your own hands, in the product, against the criteria you set before the build. "The demo looked right" is not acceptance. You will get seriously good at defining what "done right" means in a way that can actually be checked.
* **You get it adopted, and you measure.** Our products do not have revenue to hide behind. A product that ships and is not used is a failure with good release notes. You own the follow\-up, the onboarding of new users with the business, and the number that says whether the thing is working — time saved, error rate, uptake — and you report that number whether it flatters us or not.
* **You carry a portfolio, not a product.** Every product we own is built on the same scaffold and arrives the same shape, which is what makes it possible for one PO to run several — each with its own developer, each with its own business. Variety is structural here: new products keep arriving from the other half of the team.
* **Your first product is real.** A live platform that a business runs on every day — real users, real history, real stakes. You inherit it from the person who has been carrying it, and part of your first months is taken up with the most useful thing a new PO can do: learning it properly before changing it.

##### **Why this job exists — the honest version**


Here is the thing our industry has just learned, and it is the reason we are hiring you: **AI made building fast, and it did not make building the right thing any more likely.** Surveys now find most companies shipping faster with AI while almost none can point to the return. It has never been easier to run, at speed, in the wrong direction.


In a team like ours the engineers steer agents, and implementation is rarely the bottleneck. **The bottleneck is deciding** — what to build, for whom, in what order, and whether what shipped actually did what the business needed. That is not a job the agents do. It is not really a job most engineers want. It is *this* job, and in an AI\-native team it is a more senior, more consequential job than the same title has ever been — because every decision you write down gets built, quickly, exactly as you wrote it.

**What stays yours, permanently:**

* **Deciding what not to build.** The agents will cheerfully build anything. Somebody has to be the person for whom "no" is a complete sentence with a number attached.
* **The relationship.** Being trusted by a business, reading what they need underneath what they ask for, and telling them a favourite idea is not worth it — there is no model for that.
* **Precision about what should exist.** Turning a messy, human, political need into a specification with exactly one correct interpretation is the hardest writing there is, and it is now the closest thing this industry has to source code.
* **Judgement about what came back.** Acceptance, in a world where software appears fast, is the quality bar. You are it.
* **The outcome.** Whether the business is actually better off. Somebody has to own that number rather than the ship date, and it is you.

##### **You will define how the PO role works here**


You are the first. That is not a gap in the org chart — it is the offer.


How product ownership works in an AI\-native team is a genuinely open question in our industry right now, and the honest answer is that nobody's playbook fits yet. Ours will be written here, over your first year, by you and Edouard together: how needs become specs, how acceptance works when agents build, how adoption gets measured, how many products one pair can carry. The POs we hire after you will be onboarded onto the way you built.


If you have ever read a process document and thought *I could have written this better* — this is the job where you get to.

##### **You will get seriously good at building with AI**


We are an AI\-native team, genuinely — not a team that added a Copilot licence. Everyone gets their own Claude Max subscription and the tooling to use it properly, and that includes you. The product people we admire in this market prototype with AI before they ask anyone to build: a rough working version of an idea, made in an afternoon, shown to a stakeholder — because a prototype communicates intent better than any document, and because it kills bad ideas cheaply. You will learn to do that here if you cannot already, and you will learn what makes a specification one an agent builds correctly the first time. That skill is being repriced upward across our entire industry, and this is one of very few jobs where you would practise it daily on products people depend on.

##### **The Mainloop Barcelona certificate**


Something we are building alongside the team, and we think it is genuinely unusual.


Over your first two to three years here you work through a defined body of knowledge — how we build, how we run products, how a need becomes a spec becomes working, adopted software — and when you can demonstrably run a product our way, you are awarded the **Mainloop Barcelona certificate**. It is yours: it goes on your CV, and we intend to make it mean something in this market. For a product person specifically, it certifies the thing the market is newly desperate for — that you can own products in an AI\-native team, end to end, with proof.

##### **How we build**

**Every product starts from the same scaffold, and it is the same in most of our repos — deliberately.** For you that is the whole point: every product in your portfolio has the same shape, so carrying several does not mean holding several different worlds in your head. It also means the handover pack you inherit from the first half of the team actually tells you how the thing works — because it is built the way everything else is built.


You do not need to arrive knowing our tooling, and this ad deliberately lists no technologies. You need to be technical enough to hold your own in an engineering discussion, and to read what an agent produced closely enough to judge it. The rest — our architecture, our patterns, our method — is what we train you on.

##### **Things worth knowing up front**

* **Barcelona is your base, and you will spend real time with the businesses.** The products serve people across roughly fifteen countries, and the relationship is the job — expect regular travel to sit with your users, on us. It is a fraction of what our deployed engineers do, but it is not zero, and the POs who never leave the office are the ones whose products stop being used.
* **Nobody is on call. Ever.** No rota, no pager. Alerts post to a channel and wait for morning. We protect evenings with engineering, not with people.
* **Nobody counts your hours or your tickets.** What gets looked at is whether your products are used, whether the business is better off, and whether your specs held up. Outcomes, not throughput.
* **We are building the team this year, and you will shape how it works.** That is truest of all for this seat — see above.

##### **If you would be moving to Barcelona for this**

**We do not expect you to absorb the cost of relocating, and we would rather say what we cover than leave you to ask.**

* **We pay to get you here.** Flights, your first month's accommodation while you find somewhere of your own, the visa and paperwork costs, and **an agent to handle the bureaucracy** — the NIE, the TIE appointment, the apostilles — instead of leaving you to meet the Spanish administrative system alone. Spanish lessons if you want them — and in this seat they will pay for themselves.
* **A relocation bonus, paid on arrival rather than dripped out.** It is repayable only if you leave within the first eighteen months, and that condition is the reason we can pay it up front — moving countries costs money at the start, not in year two.

**Three things here are worth more than they look on an offer comparison, particularly against a US one:**

* **Healthcare with no premium, no deductible and no network** — from day one, and not tied to staying in this job.
* **Thirty calendar days of holiday — that is 22 working days — plus fourteen public holidays**, roughly seven weeks in total. That is the statutory floor in Spain, not a benefit we are being generous with.
* **Nobody is on call. Ever.** It has its own line above and we mean it literally.

**If you are coming from the United States**, two things are usually worth more than the headline salary gap and almost nobody has done the arithmetic: **a salary here can sit below the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion**, and **federal student loans on an income\-driven plan are assessed on the income that exclusion has already removed.** We are not your tax advisor and you should get one — but ask in the first conversation and we will walk you through the comparison we ran, including the parts where the number comes out smaller.

##### **What we are looking for**

**One bar sits above everything else, so here it is plainly.** You can own a product end to end — the need, the decision, the specification, the acceptance, the outcome — and you are **technical enough to contribute to an engineering discussion and to judge what an AI agent built.** You do not need to code for a living. You do need to have no fear of the inside of the machine. If you read that and thought *that is the job I want*, keep reading.

**Read the rest as a description of the person you will be here, not a checklist you have to arrive with.** Almost nobody ticks all of it on day one, and we would rather hire the judgement and train the rest.

* **You have owned something real.** A product, a platform, a module — something in production, with users, where the backlog, the priorities and the outcome were genuinely yours. We will ask you to walk us through it, and to justify specific decisions inside it.
* **You are interested in how businesses actually work.** Processes, the mess in them, and why people do the odd things they do. Our products automate administrative work, and the PO who finds that boring will be bored.
* **You write with precision, and you like it.** The spec, the acceptance criteria and the "no, because…" are all documents, all read by people (and agents) who were not in the room. If your writing is where your thinking happens, you will be at home.
* **You can say no to someone senior, with a number.** And keep the relationship.
* **You use AI seriously** — for prototyping, for analysis, for your own writing — and you read what it produces the way you would read a colleague's work: with respect and suspicion.
* **You are comfortable with engineers**, and they with you. Our model is one PO and one developer owning each product together. That pair only works if you feed each other context instead of passing tickets over a wall.
* **English, fluently.** It is our working language — we work across roughly fifteen countries. Spanish is a genuine advantage day to day, and for your first product especially. Catalan is not required.
* **Barcelona**, with travel to your businesses.

**We do not care what you studied, and a Scrum certification is neither required nor an advantage.** We care what you have owned, what happened to it, and whether you can talk us through the decisions in it.

##### **How we hire**


Our process is unusual, so here it is up front. Four rounds, and none of them is a puzzle.

* **Fifteen minutes with Edouard.** A short first conversation — who you are, what you are after, and what this actually is. Enough for both of us to work out whether the next one is worth an hour.
* **A thirty\-minute conversation.** What you have owned, how you work, and how you think about it. We will ask you to walk us through a product you owned, and then to justify one specific prioritisation decision inside it: why that, why then, what you declined to do instead. There is no way to prepare for that and it is not meant to catch you out; it is how we tell ownership from proximity.
* **A conversation with our Casablanca team.** The group has run a tech lab there for more than eight years. You get people who have run production at real scale asking their own questions — and you get to ask them yours, including the ones you would rather not ask the person hiring you.
* **A working session built around a real product.** You read a real handover pack, sit with a real stakeholder, decide what matters, write the specification and the acceptance criteria — and then watch what our agents and your developer counterpart build from it, and tell us whether you would accept it, and what it would be worth. It is the closest thing to the real job we could design, and it works both ways: you will know a great deal about whether you want to work here by the end of it.

Click\&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest\-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling \& renting boats easy. Click\&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week\-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.


**The role**


We’re looking for a Head of Product to take ownership of Product across Click\&Boat’s core business, as our VP Product shifts a significant part of his focus to our US expansion.


You’ll lead four Senior Product Managers, each owning their own squad. You’ll help them make better decisions, challenge their plans, connect the dots across squads, and make sure we’re collectively focused on the problems that matter most.


You’ll act as the VP Product’s key counterpart on the core business, with significant autonomy and responsibility for its product direction.


You’ll also work closely with the senior leadership team alongside the VP Product, giving you strong exposure to company\-level decisions and priorities.

**What floats your boat**

* **Strategy \& Execution**  

You turn strategy into clear priorities and align teams when priorities conflict.
* **Product Organization**  

You improve how the Product team operates, structuring key processes and cross\-team initiatives without adding unnecessary complexity.
* **Business \& Judgment**  

You understand the business, challenge senior stakeholders, and make sound decisions with imperfect information.
* **Team Development**  

You challenge and coach experienced PMs, helping them grow in scope and impact.

**What you bring aboard**

* You are fluent in English.
* You have significant Product experience in a mature product organization.
* You have managed experienced PMs / Senior PMs across multiple squads.
* You’re comfortable working directly with senior leadership on business and product decisions.
* You combine strategic thinking with a hands\-on, business\-oriented approach.


**The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values with our VP product and CPTO.
* Final call with Christian, our Managing Director, to wrap up the process.

**What awaits you on board**

* 8 to 10 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20\-minute walk from the sea;
* Team\-building activities.
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 3 days per month spent in Paris — around 6 to 9 trips per year.
* Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast\-growing company.

**Contract: Permanent position**

**Start date: ASAP**

**A competitive salary starting from €100K.**

**Ready to join?**


If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.


Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R\-259586 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
“It is critical that we build and maintain our rich tradition of clinical expertise in support of developing life\-changing medicines for patients.” –Jose Baselga


The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. As part of a competitively selected cohort of Scholars, you will join an accelerated development track within Oncology R\&D. With individualized mentorship, there is opportunity to learn from a diverse group of experts across the drug development continuum, playing a pivotal role in channelling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives. Selected Scholars will join the current cohort of Baselga Cancer Research Scholars, building a vibrant community of drug developers. We are currently recruiting for the 2027 class with an aim to start the position in summer\-autumn 2027\.


**About AstraZeneca Oncology Research \& Development**


Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. We’re pioneering innovative research across six scientific platforms: Tumor drivers and resistance; Immuno\-oncology, DNA damage response, Antibody drug conjugates, Epigenetics and Cell therapies.


Our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. It’s our big vision that unites and inspires us. With multiple indications and high\-quality molecules at all stages of our innovative pipeline, we keep pushing forward. Focusing on cutting\-edge science with the latest technology to achieve breakthroughs. AZ is a place built on courage, curiosity and collaboration – we make bold decisions driven by patient outcomes.


**What you’ll do**


The 2027 AZ Baselga Cancer Research Scholars cohort will join AstraZeneca at a time of tremendous growth and acceleration in the oncology biologics portfolio. Working in a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment you will experience increasing levels of responsibility, following a structured learning plan in the following domains:


1\) **Clinical Study Assignment:** You will join a clinical study team and build experience as a medical leader in clinical development which could be in Early Clinical Development, Late Clinical Development, or one year in each. You will participate in weekly clinical and scientific meetings related to your clinical study, complete AstraZeneca training programs and participate in internal and external scientific meetings. You will work in a cross functional environment, contributing to and supporting Department/Clinical initiatives to improve the quality and content of all clinical programs as well as the cross functional/organization processes designed to effectively deliver our R\&D portfolio.


Specific duties and major responsibilities for the longitudinal medical project may include any of the following:


* Serving as medical director with primary responsibility for patient safety and conduct of assigned trials as well as overall data interpretation and safety surveillance
* Establishing and approving scientific methods for design and implementation of applicable clinical protocols, data collection systems, and final reports
* Assisting in design of clinical development plans and overall strategy for compounds, therapeutic classes of compounds or indications in light of developments in the area of clinical and pharmaceutical oncology
* Collaborating with pre\-clinical and translational sciences, and senior management in assessing requirements for emerging products
* Participating in the selection and management activities of CROs
* Supervising project team members in planning, conducting and evaluating clinical trials
* Planning and managing investigator meetings, advisory boards and other scientific committees

2\) **Rotational program:** During the course of your program, you will be involved in 3\-6 month long rotations across various groups to gain a better understanding of the cross\-functional departments. This could include:


* Patient safety
* Clinical operations
* Regulatory affairs
* Biostatistics
* Medical affairs
* Translational medicine or precision medicine

3\) **Longitudinal Research Project:** You will have opportunity to lead an innovative research project of your choosing for the duration of the 2\-year program, which may be an area of special interest to you and AstraZeneca, or alternatively focus on one or more of the rotational functions. You will be able to harness rich internal datasets and expertise, aiming to deliver a research project at the end of the Program which will be presented to key internal stakeholders, at a key scientific meeting and published in a peer\-reviewed journal.


**Essential for the role:**


MD or equivalent required; ideally board certified (or eligible) preferred in Oncology or Haematology/Oncology


**Highly Desirable for the role:**


* Experience in molecular oncology and/or translational science
* Medical specialty and sub\-specialty training and Board Certification

Graphite is a fully remote vertical AI growth agency. We help clients grow through AEO and SEO\-driven content strategy, powered by a mix of specialized talent and AI tooling built for the way we work. Our team spans Content Specialists, Growth Leads, Growth Directors, and Editors, all supporting client accounts across multiple pods.


We're looking for an L\&D Coordinator to join Graphite's learning and development team. You'll work directly with our L\&D Manager to keep onboarding, training, and internal learning programs running day to day, then grow into building more of that content yourself as you settle in.


We're not looking for someone to just execute a checklist. This role needs a creative problem\-solver who writes well, thinks ahead, and brings ideas for how to do things better, not just someone who completes tasks as assigned. You'll have ownership over how programs get built and communicated, and we want someone who's enthusiastic and curious about using AI to work smarter, whether that's research, dashboards, or automating the repetitive parts of the job.


This is a foundational role on a growing team. Graphite runs L\&D through as a single person team now, and this hire is what lets it scale. You'll start focused on execution: building onboarding materials, tracking program data, and keeping our internal L\&D channel active.


Within your first year, you'll take on more content creation, community\-building, and program facilitation as you learn the business and our programs.

**This is a remote role, open to candidates based in Madrid only at this time.**

**Who you are**

* A clear, engaging writer who can make training content feel practical \& exciting.
* Organized and proactive by nature, you flag problems before they become blockers.
* Genuinely curious, you like figuring out a better way to do something rather than just doing it the way you've always done it.
* Comfortable using AI tools for research, building lightweight dashboards, or automating repetitive work, and excited to find more ways to do that.
* A creative thinker who brings ideas to the table, not just someone who waits to be told what to do.

**What you'll do**

* Build onboarding materials and online programs for new hires across our Growth, Editorial, and other areas across the company, using established templates and frameworks.
* Track completion data, quiz scores, and skill baselines, and keep our reporting trackers current.
* Coordinate logistics for training sessions and workshops: scheduling, reminders, working session setup, and feedback collection.
* Post regular updates to our L\&D Slack channel: session recaps, upcoming sessions, and useful resources for the team.
* Support our intern and shadowing programs with onboarding, tracking, and kickoff logistics.
* Help maintain compliance training materials, including templates for subject\-matter experts and completion tracking.
* As you grow in the role, take on drafting original training content (modules, decks, videos) and help build out a more consistent L\&D content and community presence company\-wide.

**Required experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in training coordination, HR, learning operations, or a related role.
* Strong writing skills, with a portfolio or writing sample that shows range.
* Comfortable working in a Learning Management System (we use Disco) or similar platform.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for research, reporting, or workflow automation, this isn't just familiarity, we want to see how you've actually used them.
* Excellent organizational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
* Genuine interest in learning and development as a career path.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with content creation: writing, video, or presentation design.
* Experience with data collection and analysis, including building charts and reports on training data.
* Familiarity with growth marketing, SEO, or AEO concepts (or willingness to learn them quickly, since our training content covers this space).
* Experience running or contributing to an internal community, newsletter, or knowledge\-sharing initiative.
* Spanish language skills (a plus given our team's regional makeup).

**How we’ll help:**


Graphite’s mission is to create an environment where you build the best work of your career. In order to facilitate this, we provide:

* **Process As Needed** \- We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes as we do products \- through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* **Autonomy** \- We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.
* **Flexible Work Environment** \- Everyone’s optimal work style is unique. We operate as a distributed team across the US, Canada, Latin America, and Europe. We optimize for productivity and performance, not time spent in an office. Help us build an optimal work environment that fits you as an individual.
* **Compensation** \- We want to work with the best people in the World and compensate accordingly.
* **Vacation \& Time Off** \- In order to be the best version of yourself, you need time to recharge. We offer flexible PTO. Take the time when you need it.

description:
AL1 busca para empresa Internacional del sector farma en etapa de expansión con alto nivel de crecimiento sostenido, un **Group Financial Reporting \& Compliance Specialist.**

Se unirá al equipo financiero internacional en plena expansión y ocupará un puesto de nueva creación donde dará forma y desarrollará la función de Cumplimiento e Información Financiera del Grupo.

Información financiera del Grupo

* Coordinar la preparación de los estados financieros legales (estatutarios) del Grupo y sus filiales.
* Apoyar el proceso anual de consolidación del Grupo y la elaboración de informes trimestrales para el Consejo de Administración.
* Garantizar el cumplimiento puntual de las obligaciones de presentación de información financiera legal en las distintas jurisdicciones.

Cumplimiento fiscal del Grupo

* Coordinar el cumplimiento fiscal periódico del Grupo (impuesto de sociedades, IVA, IRPF, declaraciones informativas).

* Actuar como enlace con organismos como CDTI, MICIU, AEAT y auditores externos.
* Apoyar la solicitud de programas de financiación nacionales y europeos (CDTI, Horizon Europe, PERTE, CIEN, NEOTEC).

CAPEX, activos intangibles y partidas del balance

* Gestionar la capitalización de activos fijos y amortizaciones (transición desde el área de Tesorería prevista para 2026\).
* Documentar y preparar la justificación de activos intangibles (especialmente en I\+D).
* Negociar rappels comerciales y revisar las pólizas de seguro de la empresa.

Auditoría externa y control interno

* Coordinar las auditorías anuales con auditores externos en las distintas jurisdicciones.
* Desarrollar y fortalecer los procedimientos de control interno y la matriz de controles (segregación de funciones/SoD, conciliaciones, autorizaciones).

Mejora de procedimientos y políticas

* Revisar los procedimientos en las distintas sedes y proponer mejoras.
* Mantener actualizadas las políticas contables y la documentación de NetSuite.
* Cumplimentar encuestas oficiales (INE, Banco de España) y atender los requisitos normativos.

Se ofrece

* Salario más bonificación.
* Horario flexible.
* Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (6 días al mes).
* 23 días de vacaciones anuales.
* Desarrollo profesional totalmente financiado, incluyendo formación técnica, certificaciones y cursos de idiomas.
* Mentoría directa por parte del CFO durante el primer año.
* Clara proyección de carrera hacia puestos de liderazgo financiero de alto nivel.
* Exposición a operaciones internacionales en diversas jurisdicciones europeas.
* Oportunidad de construir y dar forma a un área financiera de nueva creación.
* Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, internacional e impulsado por la innovación.

**Requisitos**

Formación

* Grado en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Economía o afín.
* Se valorará Máster en Auditoría, Fiscalidad, Finanzas o Cumplimiento Normativo (Compliance).
* Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales como ACCA, ROAC (en curso), CIA o similares.

Experiencia

* 3 a 5 años de experiencia en auditoría externa y/o contabilidad corporativa.
* Experiencia en la preparación de estados financieros legales/estatutarios.
* Experiencia en el apoyo a auditorías externas.
* Conocimiento de la normativa contable y fiscal española.
* Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en entornos multinacionales.
* La experiencia en precios de transferencia o subvenciones de I\+D será una ventaja, aunque no es imprescindible; ofrecemos apoyo para el aprendizaje en estas áreas.
* Idiomas: Español fluido / Inglés a nivel profesional (C1 o superior). Se valorará el conocimiento de alemán o italiano, aunque no es obligatorio.
* Este puesto requiere disponibilidad para viajar a nuestras sedes.

description:

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.


¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

Hacer crecer de forma rentable la venta online y de marketplaces, maximizar la eficiencia de la inversión en captación, elevar la recurrencia y el valor de cliente, y garantizar una experiencia de cliente coherente entre online y tienda. Dueño/a de ingresos, margen de contribución, coste de captación, devoluciones y coste de servicio del canal digital, y del roadmap de plataforma, datos y automatización que lo sostiene.

* **P\&L digital:** Objetivos anuales y trimestrales, forecast, presupuesto de inversión y seguimiento semanal frente a objetivo de online y marketplaces.
* **Roadmap digital:** Definición y priorización por impacto en margen del roadmap anual: plataforma, marketplaces, internacionalización, UX, cambios y devoluciones, logística e IA.
* **Tienda online (Shopify Plus):** Conversión, AOV y UPT; merchandising y ordenación de colecciones por modelo de scoring; landings de lanzamiento y calendario promocional con simulación de margen.
* **Marketplaces:** Apertura, consolidación y rentabilidad de El Corte Inglés, Decathlon, Veepee y Zalando: catálogo, precios, procesos y reconciliación.
* **Internacionalización:** Mercados prioritarios (PT, DE, FR, IT), monedas y pagos locales, localización de contenido y políticas de envío y devolución por mercado; modelización de escenarios de inversión (ROAS objetivo, break\-even).
* **Paid media:** Estrategia y presupuesto en Meta, TikTok y Google; objetivos de MER, blended ROAS y CAC por mercado; decisiones de escalar, pausar o reasignar en base a datos.

**Requisitos:**

* **Experiencia:** 8\+ años en ecommerce/digital en moda. 3\+ años liderando equipos multidisciplinares; ownership demostrable de un P\&L digital y de presupuestos de paid media.
* **Plataformas:** Dominio de Shopify Plus, Klaviyo, Gorgias y GA4; experiencia en marketplaces, expansión internacional e integraciones ERP/PIM/3PL. Retail omnicanal muy valorado.
* **Analítica:** SQL/ShopifyQL, Excel avanzado, modelos RFM y de cohortes, atribución multicanal y modelización financiera de escenarios.
* **IA y automatización:** Uso avanzado de herramientas de IA para análisis, reporting y operación.
* **Forma de trabajar:** Orientación a P\&L y a decisión basada en datos; ejecución directa sin depender de terceros; comunicación directa y síntesis ejecutiva; sensibilidad de marca.
* **Idiomas:** Español nativo e inglés profesional.

title: Customer Complaints Senior Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK\-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

**About the Opportunity**
The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We're a team of risk\-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.
In this role, you will own OKX's Global Customer Complaints Program and report directly to the Compliance Chief of Staff. You will work closely with Local Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams to promote consistent complaint handling across jurisdictions, maintain alignment with regulatory requirements, and provide effective second\-line oversight and challenge.
A key part of the role will be turning customer complaints into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence. You will oversee complaints governance and quality assurance, identify trends and potential systemic issues, support root\-cause analysis and remediation, and provide senior leadership with clear reporting on customer outcomes and emerging risks.
You will also support the development, coordination, and tracking of responses to regulators, working directly with Legal and Local Compliance teams on regulatory inquiries, escalated complaints, and related supervisory matters. This requires strong regulatory judgment, excellent written communication, and the ability to coordinate complex matters across multiple teams and jurisdictions.

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop, coordinate, and track responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and escalated complaints, partnering with Legal and Local Compliance teams to gather and validate facts, prepare clear and defensible responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments, remediation, and follow\-up through closure.
* Maintain global regulatory alignment by partnering with local Heads of Compliance to identify changes in jurisdictional requirements and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and local requirements remain current and appropriately implemented.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service\-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed\-loop validation.
* Own the second\-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk\-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer\-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
* Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
* Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
* Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
* Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.

**What We Look For In You**
* Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
* Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
* Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi\-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
* Strong regulatory and customer\-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer\-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
* Demonstrated experience with root\-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
* Strong second\-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk\-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.

**Nice\-To\-Haves**
* Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
* Familiarity with complaints\-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute\-resolution bodies.
* Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP\-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.



We are looking for a **Senior UX Designer** to join our international team working across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**.



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

* Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, working with legal, tax, and the in\-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted

**Delivery**

* Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches
* Identify and resolve delivery risk early, including teams that are blocked, unclear, or behind
* Manage dependencies within your area and into the connected experience areas
