* Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence
* Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams
* Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it
* Own platform NPS and adoption for the core journey, and act on the results
* Act as the product expert in senior client and prospect conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients
**Team leadership**

* Line manage the product managers within your area
* Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early
* Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability
* Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing
**What will give you an advantage**

* Eight or more years in product, including at least five leading people
* Proven experience leading product managers in a B2B SaaS or platform business, ideally where several teams contribute to a single client experience
* Experience owning a multi\-team product area end to end, with accountability for both delivery and the value delivered
* A record of defining the expected value of an investment up front and evidencing what was realised
* Knowledge of the HR industry is preferred but not critical
* Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built
* Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with engineering leadership on architecture, platform scalability, and data
* A demonstrable record of developing product managers
* Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones
**Primary performance metrics**

* **Delivery:** commitments delivered on time and to quality
* **Business impact:** value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment
* **Experience:** platform NPS
* **Adoption:** adoption of the core journey, from hiring to invoicing
*Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.*

**Competencies**

* **Product judgement:** makes clear recommendations on scope, sequencing, and trade\-offs that hold up over time
* **Strategic thinking:** sets a direction for the platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals
* **Systems thinking:** designs the journey around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value
* **Delivery leadership:** maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
* **Communication:** strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team
* **People development:** understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow
* **Influencing:** aligns commercial, engineering, and design leadership around a single sequence of work without direct authority
* **Commercial judgement:** determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case
**Key personal attributes**

* **Grit and determination:** moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily
* **Curiosity:** actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving
* **A leader and a doer:** operates strategically while staying close to the detail
* Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with

title: Lead People Partner - Technology
description:

* **Lead and grow a partner**: coach, develop and set direction for your direct report, building the partnering standard for the whole technology portfolio
* **Use people analytics to inform action**: partner with Centres of Excellence to turn data into decisions on capability, attrition and cost
* **Drive distributed team effectiveness**: optimise performance, engagement and team dynamics in a fast\-paced, asynchronous, multi\-country environment
* **Handle complex employee relations**: own the senior and sensitive end of the ER caseload for your portfolio

**Your Environment**


* **Reporting line**: People Director, alongside a peer group of senior partners covering our operating markets
* **Client group**: CTO and their leadership team across Engineering, Data, Analytics, IT and Security, plus accountability for Product via your direct report
* **Team**: one Senior People Partner reporting to you

* Remote and global savvy: experience supporting cross\-cultural teams across multiple regions

**Location \& Benefits**

* Reports to the People Director
* Professional development and coaching partnerships

title: DIRECTOR, GLOBAL MARKET INSIGHTS
description:
We’re building the future of medical dermatology by focusing on unmet patient needs and giving people the space to think independently, take ownership and make an impact that matters.  



Our purpose is simple: to transform patients’ lives by addressing real needs. We work with care, act with courage, keep things simple and focus our innovation where it makes a difference.  



Recognised as a Top Employer in Spain since 2008 and in Germany since 2025, we continue to invest in an environment where people can grow and move forward.


If you care differently, you belong here.


**MISSION**

Reporting to the VP of Center of Excellence (CoE), the Global Market Insights Director defines and leads Almirall’s global market insights capability. The role ensures the generation of robust, forward\-looking and actionable insights that inform brand, portfolio, launch and commercial decision\-making across franchises, regions and market companies.


The Director integrates primary and secondary market research, competitive intelligence, forecasting, performance analytics and emerging data sources into one coherent business view. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, the role converts evidence into clear choices, implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to move from “what happened?” to “why did it happen?”, “what is likely to happen?” and “what should we do next?”.


The role owns functional standards, governance, talent, partners and investment prioritisation for GMI, while promoting close collaboration with Franchises, Regions, Finance, Commercial Operations, Customer Experience, Marketing \& Launch Excellence, Market Access, Medical Affairs and other enabling functions. All activities must be conducted in line with applicable laws, industry codes and Almirall policies, with appropriate protection of confidential, personal and competitively sensitive information.


**CORE RESPONSABILITIES**

• **Set the GMI vision and strategy.** Define a clear, enterprise\-wide insights ambition, operating model, priorities and capability roadmap aligned with Almirall’s business and portfolio strategy.


• **Lead the Global Market Insights organisation.** Allocate resources across franchises, brands and priority business questions; clarify accountabilities; and ensure timely, high\-quality delivery across cross\-franchise and asset\-specific work.


• **Serve as a trusted strategic advisor.** Partner with senior commercial, franchise, regional and functional leaders; frame the decisions that matter; challenge assumptions constructively; and bring an independent, evidence\-based point of view.


• **Build an integrated insights ecosystem.** Connect customer, patient, market, competitor, sales, access and internal performance signals into a single narrative that identifies opportunities, risks, drivers and implications.


• **Govern global market research.** Set standards for research planning, methodology, sampling, questionnaire design, synthesis and communication; oversee high\-value qualitative and quantitative studies; and ensure that the voice of the customer informs strategy.


• **Lead competitive and market intelligence.** Establish an ethical and compliant intelligence cycle that monitors market evolution, competitor strategies, scientific and commercial developments, and emerging disruptors; translate signals into scenarios and early\-warning recommendations.


• **Own forecasting excellence.** Govern global forecasting frameworks, assumptions, scenarios and documentation across assets and markets; integrate market, epidemiology, access, competitive and performance perspectives; and improve transparency, consistency and decision usefulness.


• **Drive performance insight and business optimisation.** Monitor sales, market share, customer and execution indicators; distinguish signal from noise; identify root causes; and recommend specific actions to accelerate growth, improve launch readiness and optimise investment.


• **Strengthen portfolio and launch decisions.** Provide insight leadership across lifecycle stages, including market opportunity assessment, indication and asset prioritisation, target product profile testing, demand and uptake scenarios, launch readiness, and post\-launch learning agendas.


• **Advance analytics, data and AI\-enabled insight generation.** Promote fit\-for\-purpose use of advanced analytics, automation and artificial intelligence; partner on data quality and governance; and ensure that innovation remains business\-led, transparent, responsible and scalable.


• **Create decision\-focused reporting and storytelling.** Establish concise dashboards, executive narratives and structured performance forums that communicate not only findings, but also implications, choices, risks and recommended actions.


• **Lead external partners and GMI investment.** Select and manage research, data and analytics partners; set clear quality expectations; prioritise spend against strategic value; ensure procurement and compliance requirements; and build internal capability where it creates sustainable advantage.


• **Develop talent and functional excellence.** Coach, empower and retain a diverse, high\-performing GMI team; build business acumen, consultative influence, methodological expertise and digital fluency; create succession and development plans; and foster accountability and continuous learning.


• **Embed global\-local collaboration.** Create effective feedback loops with regions and market companies, balancing global consistency with local relevance, and enabling reuse of evidence, methods and learning across the organisation.


• **Champion change and continuous improvement.** Challenge the status quo, simplify ways of working and anticipate future capability needs while balancing urgent business requirements with long\-term value creation.


**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.


* Minimum 10–12 years of progressive experience in market insights, market research, forecasting, business analytics, competitive intelligence or strategic marketing within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or closely related healthcare sector.
* Proven experience leading a global or regional insights function and developing people in an international, matrix organisation.
* Demonstrated mastery of primary and secondary research, forecasting, competitive intelligence, performance analytics and insight synthesis, with the judgement to select the right approach for the business question.
* Strong pharmaceutical business acumen, including brand strategy, launches, lifecycle management, customer and patient dynamics, market access and the global\-local operating model.
* Experience influencing senior leaders and cross\-functional teams through clear recommendations, constructive challenge and compelling executive communication.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, external partners and significant research or data investments with a focus on quality, impact and efficiency.
* Fluent English, written and spoken, with the ability to operate effectively across cultures and geographies.

**PREFERRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCES**

* MBA, MSc, PhD or other relevant advanced degree.
* Experience in both affiliate or regional roles and a global commercial organisation.
* Experience in dermatology, immunology, specialty care and/or biologics, including launch and lifecycle insight needs (Desirable).
* Expertise integrating diverse evidence, such as market research, claims or patient data, epidemiology, sales, digital engagement, CRM and competitive intelligence, into an unbiased, decision\-ready point of view.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualisation, automation and responsible AI applications in commercial decision\-making.
* Exceptional strategic thinking, problem framing, synthesis, storytelling and executive presence.
* Strong people leadership: creates clarity, develops talent, delegates effectively, gives candid feedback and builds an inclusive, high\-accountability culture.
* Enterprise mindset and collaboration skills, with the confidence to influence without authority and reconcile different stakeholder perspectives.
* High learning agility, curiosity, resilience and comfort operating in ambiguous, complex and fast\-changing environments.
* Working knowledge of global healthcare regulation, privacy, pharmacovigilance interfaces and applicable pharmaceutical industry codes relevant to market research and competitive intelligence.

title: Director of Analytics, Interim
description:

**Requirements:**

title: Senior Director, Technical Services
description:
#### **About Parsec**



Parsec Automation, LLC (Parsec) is a trailblazing creator and provider of manufacturing operations management software. Consistently recognized by organizations like Gartner and IDC and a winner of numerous awards, including the Data Breakthrough Awards, American Business, and Best in Biz, Parsec exemplifies leadership in the dynamic, fast\-paced manufacturing sector. With major companies such as Johnson \& Johnson, Merck, Toyota, Proctor \& Gamble, Eli Lilly, Hershey, Siemens, and DuPont leveraging its innovative TrakSYS™ platform to tackle even the most complex manufacturing challenges, Parsec's solutions are actively optimizing efficiency, quality, and compliance at over 11,000 plants in more than 140 countries. Committed to customer success and driven by innovation, Parsec continues to fulfill its mission of making the management of manufacturing operations as simple as possible.



Parsec is backed by BVP Forge, a $780M fund in partnership with the $20B Bessemer platform that has backed industry\-defining businesses such as LinkedIn, MindBody, Procore, Shopify, and Toast. BVP Forge combines Bessemer's front\-line industry insights, proven growth IP, and robust executive network with tailored resources for self\-sustaining companies and the ForgeEdge™ operational program.

  


**The Role**



Parsec is hiring a **Senior Director, Technical Services** to unify and scale the technical backbone of its Professional Services organization. This role owns three distinct but interdependent workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support. Each currently operates with its own rhythm, skill set, and client touchpoints. The mandate for this role is to bring these workstreams together under one operating model so that clients, SI partners, and internal teams experience a consistent standard of technical excellence, regardless of which workstream is engaged.



This is a build\-and\-run role. The teams exist today; the person in this seat will professionalize how they operate, scale them as the business grows, and ensure new hires ramp to full productivity on a defined timeline. Success is measured by predictable delivery, fewer escalations, improved resource utilization across workstreams, and a technical organization that partners with Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners as a single, credible voice on TrakSYS.

  


**Role Characteristics**


* **Organizational Span:** Owns three workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support, all spanning approximately 30–40 FTEs based primarily in the US and Spain, with additional coverage across Europe.
* **Delivery Accountability:** Accountable for delivery outcomes across all three workstreams, including quality, timeliness, and client/partner satisfaction.
* **Governance \& Control:** Establishes shared standards, handoff protocols, and reporting cadence across workstreams (capacity planning, utilization, backlog health, escalation tracking).
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership**: Serves as the primary point of contact for workstream health, capacity, and delivery status communications to PS leadership.
* **Collaboration:** Works closely with Project Managers (who retain ownership of individual engagements), Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners.
* **Scaling:** Builds hiring plans, role profiles, interview standards, and leveling criteria to support growth across all three workstreams.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Advisory Workstream**


* Own the quality bar for design artifacts produced by Solution Architects and Tech Leads, ensuring consistency across SI partner\-led and Parsec\-led engagements.
* Deploy Advisory resources across concurrent engagements, balancing SI support requests against direct delivery needs.
* Build and maintain design standards, reference architectures, and reusable artifacts that reduce rework across engagements.
* Serve as the escalation point for design decisions that carry architectural or precedent\-setting weight.

  


* **Delivery Workstream**


* Manage the engineering resource pool as a shared capacity model: intake, prioritization, staffing, and rebalancing across concurrent projects.
* Partner with assigned Project Managers on scope, timelines, and quality gates without owning the PM function.
* Set and enforce engineering and QA standards across POC, enhancement, and targeted delivery work.
* Track velocity and throughput to inform capacity planning and hiring timing.

  


* **Support Workstream**


* Own support SLAs, coverage models, and on\-call structures across a 24/7, multi\-region team.
* Ensure upgrade assessments, upgrades, and technical reviews follow a consistent methodology and artifact set.
* Develop a repeatable mentoring and knowledge\-transfer offering for clients and SI partners.
* Feed recurring support themes and technical debt patterns back into Advisory and Engineering to address root causes.

  


* **Cross\-Workstream Responsibilities**


* Establish shared standards and communication norms so clients and SI partners receive a consistent experience across Advisory, Delivery, and Support.
* Build the metrics, reporting cadence, and operating rhythm that make delivery predictable and visible to leadership (dashboard support provided by the Operations team).
* Partner with Enablement to define ramp paths and curricula for new hires and ongoing development paths for tenured staff.
* Report on workstream health, capacity, and delivery metrics to PS leadership, and translate technical delivery performance into terms an executive audience can act on.

  


* **Success Measures**


* Advisory, Delivery, and Support operate against shared standards and a shared reporting model.
* New hires reach full productivity on a defined, predictable timeline, in partnership with Enablement.
* Delivery predictability improves, reflected in fewer escalations, tighter SLA adherence, and more accurate capacity forecasting.
* Clients and partners experience a consistent technical governance model across all three workstreams.
* Leadership has real\-time visibility into workstream health, capacity, and risk.

  


**Qualifications**


* **Experience:** 10\+ years in technical delivery, professional services, or engineering leadership within enterprise software, industrial software, or MES/manufacturing operations platforms.
* **Multi\-Function Leadership**: Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical functions concurrently (e.g., solution architecture/advisory, engineering delivery, and technical support) as a unified organization.
* **Distributed Teams:** Experience managing distributed, international teams; direct experience with US/Europe (Spain in particular) team structures is a strong plus.
* **Scaling:** Track record of building or scaling a technical delivery function during a growth phase, including hiring plans and ramp/enablement design.
* **Operational Skills**: Strong operational instincts in capacity planning, utilization management, SLA and escalation frameworks, and delivery metrics.
* **Range:** Comfortable operating at both the strategic level (org design, executive reporting) and the technical level (credible in design and architecture conversations).
* **Partner Ecosystem:** Experience working with or alongside System Integrator (SI) and Global SI (GSI) partner ecosystems.
* **Platform Experience:** Direct experience with MES, MOM, or industrial automation platforms (TrakSYS or comparable platforms) preferred.

  


**Benefits**


* $200,000–$255,000 base, plus bonus eligibility
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Professional development and career growth opportunities
* Collaborative and innovative work environment
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a growing global software company

  


**Location**



This is a fully remote position.

You bring a deep understanding of the clinical development and clinical operations personas, know the clinical ecosystem (EDC, CDMS, CTMS, eTMF), and can engage credibly with clinical operations leaders, medical directors, biostatisticians, data managers, and regulatory professionals.

description:
**About Us**

**The Role**


You will be the editing engine of a performance pod: a small team built around a creative strategist, a media buyer, and a copywriter, shipping direct\-response ads for claims\-led health and wellness brands. This is not a brand content role and not an organic social role. Every asset you cut exists to convert on paid traffic, and your work is measured by how it performs, not only by how it looks.


The creative challenge is specific: our products solve problems (chronic pain, mobility, wellbeing) whose results are not visually obvious. Your edits build belief through mechanism explanation, testimonials, UGC structures, advertorials, and VSL\-style long form, always with awareness that we operate in a compliance\-sensitive category. You will produce both short\-form ads (15 to 60 seconds) and long\-form direct\-response formats (2 to 6 minutes), and a large part of your week is iterating winners: new hooks, new openings, cutdowns, and format variations of ads that are already scaling.


This is a high\-volume seat and we say so openly. The target output is at least one long\-form ad of around 5 minutes plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos per working day, which comes to roughly 15 to 20 delivered assets per week including iterations. If that rhythm sounds extreme, this is not the right role. If it sounds like the environment you already work in, we should talk.

**What You Will Own**


Direct\-response editing at volume. Editing short\-form and long\-form paid ads from strategist scripts and briefs, shipping platform\-native formats for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, and sustaining the daily delivery target of one long\-form plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos without sacrificing the craft details that drive performance: hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.


Winner iteration and creative testing. Producing hook variations, cutdowns, re\-orders, and format swaps of winning ads as a first\-class deliverable. Feeding the testing loop the pod runs every week and turning performance feedback into the next round of edits quickly.


Claims\-led storytelling. Building belief for outcomes the viewer cannot see: visualizing mechanisms, structuring testimonial and UGC narratives, editing advertorial and VSL long form that holds attention for minutes, and handling claims with compliance awareness.


Pod collaboration and documentation. Working async\-first inside the pod with your strategist and media buyer, keeping Asana as the single source of truth for briefs, versions, and delivery status, and turning feedback into revised cuts without friction or ego.

 **Requirements**  

Proven experience editing paid direct\-response ads for DTC or ecommerce brands, where your videos ran on real media budgets and you saw the numbers. Fluency in both short\-form ad formats and long\-form DR (VSLs, advertorials, 2\+ minute belief\-building videos). A demonstrated high\-volume rhythm: you have sustained daily ad output in a testing environment, not one polished piece per week. Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) and a track record of letting data change your edits. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or other claims\-sensitive verticals is a strong plus. Full professional proficiency with a modern editing stack, reliable remote setup, and the self\-management to thrive in an async\-first, output\-measured company.

 **Benefits**  

A fully remote position at a high\-growth DTC operator launching new brands. Real ownership inside a performance pod where your work directly drives scale. Paid time off, wellness stipend, company\-funded computer allowance after tenure milestone, monthly bonus structure, birthday gift card, and in\-country meetup allowance. title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Senior GTM Engineer
description:
Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens
Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast\-growing B2B brands, YC \& Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market through predictable, scalable outbound systems.


We're looking for a **Senior GTM Engineer** to own and evolve our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts.


This is a hands\-on senior role sitting at the intersection of **data, automation, AI, deliverability, intent signals, and outbound strategy**. Beyond building systems yourself, you’ll help set technical standards, introduce new GTM technologies, and mentor other team members.


This is a full\-time, remote role, working EU hours.


About the role
You’ll work closely with GTM Strategists, Campaign Managers, and other GTM Engineers to architect scalable outbound systems from ICP definition through campaign execution and reporting.


You’ll own complex Clay workflows, data infrastructure, intent and signal\-based targeting, automation, and deliverability, while continuously testing new AI and GTM tools that can improve our results.


We’re looking for someone who can not only build great systems, but also **lead technically, challenge existing processes, and help raise the standard of the wider team.**


What you’ll do ✨* **Architect end\-to\-end outbound systems**, from ICP and TAM definition through enrichment, sequencing, CRM sync, and performance reporting

* Own and improve **email deliverability infrastructure**, including domains, inbox health, sending infrastructure, authentication, reputation, and scaling best practices
* Design **intent and signal\-based outbound systems** using signals such as job changes, funding, hiring activity, website intent, technology adoption, social activity, and other buying signals
* Build automation workflows with **n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks**
* Use AI and LLMs to improve prospect research, qualification, personalization, data processing, and campaign workflows

* Write lightweight Python or JavaScript and work directly with APIs when no\-code tools aren’t enough
* Partner with GTM Strategists to improve targeting, campaign architecture, and outbound performance
* Establish best practices and documentation for GTM engineering workflows
* **Mentor junior and mid\-level GTM Engineers**, review workflows, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team develop technically
* Proactively identify inefficient processes and design better, more scalable solutions

  

**Requirements**  

  

Who you are ❤️‍
You should have:

* 3\+ years of experience in GTM Engineering, RevOps, outbound operations, growth engineering, or a closely related role
* Strong hands\-on experience building outbound systems in a B2B SaaS, GTM agency, consultancy, or fast\-moving technology environment
* Advanced experience with **Clay**, including complex enrichment workflows, Claygent, AI columns, waterfalls, and APIs
* Strong understanding of **email deliverability**, sending infrastructure, domain reputation, authentication, and inbox health
* Experience designing campaigns around **intent data and buying signals**, rather than relying only on static prospect lists
* Strong knowledge of the modern GTM tooling ecosystem and genuine curiosity around emerging AI and automation tools
* Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, automation platforms, and basic Python or JavaScript
* A strong commercial mindset — you understand ICPs, messaging, outbound performance, pipeline, and why targeting decisions matter
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to design systems rather than simply execute predefined tasks
* Experience mentoring, supporting, or reviewing the work of other team members
* Excellent English communication skills (C1–C2\), with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience working with Tech, SaaS, or B2B software companies


We’re also open to candidates coming from **RevOps, growth engineering, Clay consulting, outbound operations, or highly technical SDR/BDR backgrounds** who have transitioned into systems building.


What good looks like
You are successful in this role if:

* GTM Strategists trust the systems and data you build without needing to recheck everything
* Our outbound infrastructure remains scalable, reliable, and deliverability\-safe
* Intent signals help us identify better prospects and improve campaign timing
* Clay and automation workflows are clean, efficient, documented, and cost\-effective
* You regularly introduce new AI, automation, and GTM approaches that improve how the team works
* You identify problems before they become bottlenecks
* Other GTM Engineers improve through your mentoring and technical guidance
* You help the team move faster while maintaining a high standard of data and execution quality


This role is not for you if* You have never used Clay or similar GTM automation tools

* You have little understanding of email deliverability
* You prefer executing instructions rather than designing systems and proposing improvements
* You are not interested in experimenting with new AI and GTM technologies
* You are uncomfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems
* You do not enjoy mentoring or sharing knowledge with other team members

  

**Benefits**  

In addition to joining a fast\-growing GTM team, we offer:

* Collaborative, friendly, and ambitious team

* Team\-building activities
* Free books and Kindles to support your development

* Opportunity to work with international B2B brands, startups, and scaleups

About Our Organization:


Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. About Dow Jones Design \& Research:


Our Design \& Research org brings together world\-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.


Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135\-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.


About the Role:


We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to set design strategy across multiple product areas and shape how Dow Jones approaches design at scale. This is one of our most senior individual contributor roles, requiring someone who can work directly with executive leadership to resolve strategic conflicts and identify company\-wide opportunities.


As a Principal Product Designer, you'll have unique visibility across product areas and platforms, enabling you to spot patterns and opportunities that others miss. You'll work directly with SLT, ELT, and C\-suite executives to shape company direction, while your design patterns become standards across major portions of Dow Jones. This role demands someone who can navigate extreme complexity, influence at the highest levels, and establish practices that become industry benchmarks.


You'll be the design voice for challenges that lack precedent, developing senior talent across multiple product areas while representing Dow Jones at industry events. Your work will directly impact business metrics across multiple years, positioning our company ahead of industry transformations.


The Principal Product Designer will report to a Sr. Manager, Director, Sr. Director, or VP within the Design \& Research organization.


You Will:


* Set design strategy across multiple product areas and their platform connections, working directly with SLT, ELT, and C\-suite executives to shape company direction. You'll resolve conflicts between different strategic directions and help Dow Jones adapt to market changes through design leadership.
* Present to and influence executive leadership, demonstrating how thoughtfully designed products and platforms create competitive advantage. You'll synthesize competing executive concepts into unified direction and counsel leaders on decisions that reshape our entire portfolio.
* Lead company\-wide strategic projects requiring alignment across all products, platforms, and business units. You'll partner with executives to remove organizational barriers and reshape how Dow Jones creates products at scale.
* Identify company\-wide opportunities through your unique visibility across product areas and platforms, spotting patterns that inform multi\-year strategic planning. You'll anticipate industry transformations and position Dow Jones ahead of change.
* Establish design practices that become industry benchmarks, developing new methods, frameworks, and tools that improve design practice company\-wide. You'll share these approaches externally through speaking engagements and publications.
* Solve highly ambiguous, precedent\-setting challenges by developing new approaches that become standard practice across the organization. You'll navigate extreme complexity to create clear strategies for executive decision\-making.
* Shape platform evolution across multiple product areas, defining how platform designs create competitive advantage and enable capabilities that demonstrate real value to users and executives.
* Develop senior design talent across multiple product areas, mentoring Principal\-level designers and advising executives on design leadership. You'll create talent pipelines and foster inclusion in high\-stakes decisions.
* Set and embody quality standards that influence major portions of Dow Jones, establishing processes that maintain excellence across all products, markets, and platforms worldwide.
* Build external partnerships with agencies, vendors, and academic institutions that enhance our capabilities, while establishing Dow Jones's reputation as a design leader through industry presence.

You Have:


* 10\+ years of product design experience, with significant time spent setting strategy for complex, multi\-product organizations.
* A portfolio demonstrating strategic impact at scale, showing how you've shaped company direction, resolved conflicts between competing strategies, and delivered measurable business value across multiple years.
* Proven track record working with C\-level executives, presenting to boards, and influencing company\-wide decisions through design leadership.
* Experience setting design strategy for multiple product areas simultaneously, with demonstrated ability to balance competing priorities and resolve strategic conflicts.Excellence in platform thinking, with a history of establishing patterns that become standards across major portions of an organization.
* Demonstrated thought leadership through speaking at major conferences, published articles, or industry recognition for design excellence.
* Track record of solving unprecedented challenges, creating new methods or frameworks when existing approaches don't suffice.
* Strong business acumen with ability to connect design decisions to multi\-year business outcomes, speaking fluently about metrics, market dynamics, and competitive positioning.
* Experience building design capabilities at scale, including establishing operations, governance models, and talent development programs.
* Proven ability to navigate organizational complexity, working across business units, geographies, and cultures to drive alignment on strategic initiatives.
* Deep expertise across design disciplines, from visual design to systems thinking, with ability to coach others and set standards for excellence.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Design, HCI, or related field (advanced degree strongly preferred).

**Job ID** R\-259127 **Date posted** 08/31/2026

**Introduction to role**


BioPharmaceuticals Medical (BPM) ensures the best patient outcomes by providing healthcare decision\-makers around the world with the evidence and confidence they need on AstraZeneca therapies and support our internal stakeholders with medical insight and expertise. BPM provides medical leadership with market participation and connectivity while also impacting the life cycle planning and execution of all our products. The Senior Director, Health Data Implementation is part of the Global BPM Evidence organization; reporting directly to the Head, Real World Science \& Analytics. * Plan and advocate for the scaling RWD programs to maximize practice change opportunities (e.g., leading pan\-market implementation teams), including resource management

* Discover new use cases for RWD impact by exploring diverse datasets, assessing feasibility and evaluating new technologies – while forging novel opportunities for RWD impact across R\&D, Government Affairs, Market Access and beyond
* Understand and communicate on technologies behind RWD knowledge management and data insight tools
* Translate problems into specific analytical questions and form hypotheses that can be answered with RWD
* Publish research into the areas of automation and visualization for generating Real World Evidence
* Lead senior leader and cross\-functional engagement to scale RWD platforms strategically and sustainably, including our global/local RWD community of practice
* Mentorship and oversight of other RWD leaders within BPM Evidence and related functional areas

**Education, Qualifications and Experience**


**Essential**


* Business and/or medical science degree with commercial experience is required

* Experience in healthcare or biopharma industry, with a preference for experience in R\&I and CVRM therapeutic areas

title: Senior Marketing Artist (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.  

  

We are looking for a **Senior Marketing Artist** to join our international team working on **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**.



We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high\-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.



You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials \- from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.



This is not a purely execution\-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.



You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution \- someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.



We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs \- spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET \+/\- 2 hour)**



If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **6\+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.**
* Basic knowledge of or hands\-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
* Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
* Proven experience creating assets such as:
* + key visuals and campaign artwork
	+ promotional and store screenshots
	+ banners and social media assets
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ promotional compositions based on in\-game or 3D content
* Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
* Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy


**Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms**


* Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
* Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
* Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post\-processing skills
* Ability to take existing in\-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
* Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
* Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
* Proactive, self\-driven mindset and ability to work independently
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


Due to the seniority of this role, we will only consider candidates who meet the requirements above.


### **Nice to have**


* Experience with motion graphics or video editing
* Familiarity with Figma
* UI/UX or in\-game UI experience
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Executive Producer
* Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
* Create high\-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
* Develop compelling visual concepts based on in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
* Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
* + key visuals
	+ promotional screenshots and beauty shots
	+ store and platform assets
	+ banners
	+ social media graphics
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ campaign visuals
	+ event and presentation materials
	+ other 2D promotional artwork
* Capture, compose and post\-process in\-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
* Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
* Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
* Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
* Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
* Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
* Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high\-quality final state
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Strong visual judgment** – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
* **Speed, clarity and ownership** – we expect results, not status updates
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
* **Purpose\-driven design** – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
* **Versatility** – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
* **Direct communication and execution** – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs
  


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

title: Head of Engineering, Supply Chain
description:
**Who We Are**



Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all\-in\-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross\-border, and business management tools each month.



As Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country's point\-of\-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.


**Why Spain**



Some of our most mission\-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest\-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.



So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in Spain.


**About The Role**



POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale \- making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.



The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:


* Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
* Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
* Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
* Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
* Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
* Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.

description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


We are looking for Design Engineers (product focussed, with Frontend\-leaning/UX) to develop and maintain the Creative \& Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features. You will also help to mentor our less experienced Frontend\-leaning engineers on the team.

**Your general responsibilities will include:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting\-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

* High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end\-to\-end features across the full stack of Creative products, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.
* Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.


We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.




**Specific responsibilities might include:**
--------------------------------------------

* Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.
* Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break\-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.
* Collaborate with Design, Engineering and Growth to ensure cohesive end\-to\-end web experiences.
* Execute and iterate on designs based on user feedback, and best practices.
* Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.
* Working to collect, manage, and process massive\-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

**Requirements**
----------------


We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.


**We do require:**

* Frontend Engineer experience with an eye for design, and are proficient in Next.js, React, and likely design libraries like Shadcn, Framer Motion or D3\.
* Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React
* You have a portfolio showcasing web projects and your ability to craft compelling web experiences, with a strong preference on personal branding.
* Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.
* Bonus: experience building media or creative products serving enterprise customers

------------


This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.


\#LI\-Remote
