* Establish roadmap priorities and quarterly focuses for the channel, and report on them monthly with the same rigour as a sales forecast.
* Design and deliver onboarding and enablement for new partners, so they understand our proposition and can position us accurately.
* Nurture existing partner relationships so that RemotePass is the provider they think of first, and so referral volume grows over time.
* Work with our go\-to\-market engineer to make partner\-sourced pipeline properly traceable in our CRM, so channel contribution can be measured and defended.
* Co\-sell with our account executives, bringing partners into live opportunities and owning the handoffs in both directions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, Product and Operations, to align channel goals with wider company objectives.
* Monitor and analyse channel performance, identify what is not working, and act on it.
* Act as the main point of contact for our partners, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and competitor channel programmes, and make recommendations accordingly.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations on channel performance for management and key stakeholders.

  

**Requirements**  

* + 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B SaaS or professional services, with at least 2 in channel, partnerships, alliances or partner\-led business development.
	+ A current or recent role that is hands\-on.
	+ Evidence of building rather than maintaining.
	+ Comfort with outbound partner recruitment.
	+ An understanding of how partner contribution is measured, and a view on how it should be
	+ Strong understanding of partner acquisition and engagement strategies.
	+ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to build credibility with senior people at professional services firms, where the person across the table is an adviser rather than a buyer.
	+ Proficient in data analysis and metrics reporting.
	+ Strong organisational and project management skills, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
	+ Familiarity with CRM systems, ideally HubSpot

  

**Benefits**  

* Be part of a fast\-growing global company revolutionizing remote work management.
* Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values innovation and creativity.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive, uncapped variable compensation tied directly to the accounts you grow.

title: People Systems & Automation Engineer
description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people \- helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.


What started in Poland is now an international, cloud\-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.


For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.


Working in a rapidly growing, ever\-changing scale\-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.  

  

**The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:**  

As an People System \& Automation Engineer reporting to the Head of People Technology, your purpose will be to build the automations that free our People \& Culture teams from admin and to own them end to end.

* Build integrations and workflows against live systems: BigQuery, Google Cloud, Apps Script, and our HR and hiring platform APIs
* Put Claude and Gemini into production workflows, with guardrails and a human checkpoint wherever judgement is needed
* Design configurable engines rather than one\-off scripts — you'll be the one maintaining them
* Work with process owners across People \& Culture to turn what they actually do into something buildable
* Track the hours and cost your work frees up, and report it


We've mapped over 200 processes. The principle behind every build: automate the admin, keep the judgement human. You'll be levelled and mentored inside our Product \& Tech function, working alongside our existing engineer.

 **Requirements** **Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…**

* Strong BigQuery and SQL skills you'll be tested on this early in the process
* Expert\-level workflow automation: multi\-step scenarios, branching, data stores, error handling and webhooks
* Practical experience putting LLMs into production with structured outputs, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Discretion with sensitive data — pay, performance and candidate information, handled in line with GDPR
* At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business\-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

**It will also help you to have…**

* Working code ability — JavaScript (Google Apps Script) and/or Python for the glue no\-code can't reach
* Google Cloud experience (Firebase, AI Studio)
* Experience taking a non\-technical team through a change in how they work, not just shipping the tool

  

**Benefits**  

We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote\-first.


Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote \- either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.


Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.  

  

**How AI helps us find great people**


Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role \- but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application \- it won't affect your chances in any way.

**Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:**


We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

title: Engineering Director - Platform
description:

You will own the Platform end\-to\-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.


The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.


This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.


We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade\-offs between long\-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.

  


ResponsibilitiesPlatform Strategy \& Architecture* Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
* Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
* Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
* Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
* Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business\-critical.
* Balance long\-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.


Reliability \& Engineering Excellence* Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
* Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident\-management practices.
* Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
* Lead post\-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.

* Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.

* Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
* Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
* Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**ABOUT US**



In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best\-in\-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry\-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4\.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.


**LIFE AT TKWW**



At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well\-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.


### **ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**



TKWW is looking for a **Senior Data Scientist** to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross\-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data\-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.


### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
* Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
* Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
* Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
* Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self\-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
* Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
* Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
* Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

  


### **REQUIREMENTS:**


* Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data\-driven insights and recommendations
* Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
* Hands\-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
* Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production\-ready queries
* Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
* Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
* Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross\-functional environment
* Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred
* 2\+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, with some prior leadership, mentorship, or project ownership experience
* Fluent in English \& Spanish


**WORK MODEL:**



This role is Together@TKWW\-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You’ll be expected to work in the office **two days a week** as part of our hybrid work model.

  



 \#LI\-Hybrid



\#professional


**AI FLUENCY**



At TKWW, AI is a tool that helps our teams work smarter, move faster, and spend more time on the work that matters most. We expect every employee, in every role, to build fluency with the AI tools relevant to their work, use them thoughtfully and with sound judgment, and bring curiosity as these tools keep evolving. This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.


**WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:**


* **Commit to our customers**: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
* **Raise the bar:** You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
* **Be all in:** You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
* **Celebrate impact:** You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way. You love to win, together.


**WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:**



We provide meaningful, high\-impact benefits designed to support the holistic well\-being of our diverse workforce and help our people thrive both professionally and personally. From physical and mental wellness to flexible time off our programs are built around the moments that matter most.


**TOGETHER@TKWW: OUR APPROCH TO HYBRID WORK**

title: HEAD OF PRODUCTION
description:
**Presentación de grupo**  

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.



TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50\.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

 **Quiénes somos**  

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A\-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR\-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor \& Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.



We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.



Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1\.8 billion passengers worldwide.



Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

 **Qué esperamos** **Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead the daily execution of production across assembly lines, workshops, shifts, and teams, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives.


* Exercise visible safety leadership on the shop floor, ensuring that higher\-risk tasks are properly controlled, and investigate incidents to implement sustainable corrective actions.


* Lead and develop direct labor, supervisors, and line leaders, ensuring appropriate staffing levels, shift planning, multi\-skilling, training, and succession planning.


* Ensure the stability, standardization, and performance of assembly lines and production processes, coordinating with Engineering on new products and process changes.


* Lead preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance of equipment and facilities, ensuring the availability, reliability, and legal compliance of production assets.


* Control production hours, efficiency, conversion cost, and cost centers, preparing and monitoring the annual production and maintenance budget.


* Apply Lean Manufacturing and Kaizen methodologies, with structured problem\-solving, to drive sustainable productivity and quality improvements.


* Propose and support the prioritization of industrial investments in production and maintenance, ensuring proper execution once approved.


* Coordinate closely with Logistics, PSM, Engineering, Quality, Projects, and HR to ensure material availability, sequencing, and on\-time delivery.


* Maintain a professional and constructive relationship with HR and worker representatives on matters within their scope.

 **A quién buscamos** **Requirements:**


* Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Organization, or equivalent technical qualification.


* Solid, proven experience leading production in complex, configurable, or project\-based industrial environments.


* Demonstrable responsibility for direct labor, production supervisors, assembly lines, and operational results.


* Relevant experience in industrial maintenance or in close coordination with a maintenance function.


* Proven track record recovering production plans, managing bottlenecks, and stabilizing operational processes.


* Experience in labor relations, change management, and factory team development.


* Practical, hands\-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, problem\-solving, standardization, and visual management.


* User experience with ERP/MRP systems for production, cost, and maintenance control; knowledge of SAP is especially valued.


* Exposure to international environments or collaboration with plants and teams in other countries.


* Professional English to collaborate at Business Unit level and with other sites.


**Competencies we value**



Visible safety leadership, focus on execution and production results, people leadership and labor relations management, focus on maintenance and reliability, quality, productivity, and cost management, financial and budgetary control, and cross\-functional collaboration without encroaching on other areas' scope.

 **Contacto**  

APPLICATIONS VIA WEB

* The opportunity to lead production at a specialized, growing engineering and manufacturing center within the airport mobility sector.


* An on\-site leadership role in Mieres (Asturias), close to the shop floor and the production teams.

title: Merchandising Manager Women’s Bags EMEA – Maternity Cover
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.


As **Merchandising Manager** **Women’s Bags EMEA** , you will support the Head of Merchandising to develop, review and deliver the merchandising strategy and successfully build the assortment by store, meeting company targets in terms of net sales and Sell\-through for your owned category. You will contribute to developing the merchandising function both strategically and operationally, developing and implementing the right processes and tools and working closely with all teams to further drive growth of the LOEWE business in the region.


Reporting to Regional Director for LG Merchandising \& Head of Merchandising for ME
  

Based in LOEWE’s Madrid Head Office.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Responsible for defining optimal seasonal buys for the stores in your scope within the limits of the OTB provided and ST% targets. Including Pre\-co, Fashion Show and Capsules.
* Act as key point of contact for all info related to Product and Merchandising in the region. Together with Head of Merchandising present the buying strategy and key bets for the categories under his/her responsibility to the key stakeholders of the region to ensure the alignment towards the final sales and ST% targets.
* Responsible of the information flow to the stores regarding launching plan, ST%, sales achievements along the season, highlighting strengths and weaknesses by store and by product to improve the KPIS regarding stock, sales, ABP and UPT.
* Responsible for the weekly trade reporting \& ad hoc analysis supporting the Head of Merchandising.
* Study performance and demands, gathering direct feedback from sales staff in stores, and compiling seasonal in\-depth sell\-in and sell\-out analysis to share with management. Provide qualitative feedback to Central Merchandising.
* Define of the allocation strategy by store based on their historic performance and new opportunities \& optimize stocks via monthly consolidation strategy partnering with SC team for execution.
* Work with Visual Merchandising team to ensure alignment in terms of store needs, stock availability and sales push when needed.
* Strong and effective collaboration with Store Managers:
	+ Make sure Store Managers are on board with the merchandising vision for the region.
	+ Define an effective communication process with the Store Managers and key stake holders.

*RELEVANT KPIS:*

* *Net sales and growth*
* *Seasonal ST%*
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* 3\-5 years of experience as Merchandiser in Leathergoods/Bags, preferably in luxury.
* Excellent numeric, analytical and strong decision\-making skills.
* Outstanding attention to details.
* Motivated by a challenging brief and shows a can\-do attitude.
* Excellent at working and delivering against deadlines and able to work effectively under pressure and in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong sense of international fashion and trends.
* A real passion for LOEWE and our collections.
* A proactive approach in tackling issues and ability to identify and implement solutions.
* Strong out\-of\-the\-box thinking.
* A good team player, able to work autonomously with high levels of motivation.
* Excellent organisational and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritise and be able to multitask.
* Excellent communication skills, confident in influencing people at all levels, and highly skilled in presentations.
* Proactive and positive approach.
* In\-depth knowledge of Excel is required. Power BI is a strong plus.
* Fluency in English is essential. Spanish and any other language is a plus.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Revenue Manager

We are seeking an experienced Revenue Manager for The Hoxton, Madrid.


The Hoxton is coming to Madrid, a vibrant city of historic streets, buzzing plazas, creative energy, and a lively food scene. Located centrally on Plaza de Santa Ana, the hotel will feature 192 guest\-rooms across five classic Hox categories, an open\-plan lobby with all\-day coffee, rooftop bar Cayo Coco for sundown cocktails, authentic Italian restaurant Bambini Club, and The Apartment \- The Hoxton’s signature meeting and event space.

You will develop and implement strategic commercial plans, together with the General Manager and Director of Sales, to drive and grow revenue across all segments, constantly monitoring results and adjusting strategies and activities to make sure objectives and targets are being met
* Effectively incorporate the revenue management philosophy of exceeding our fair share from three key perspectives, Mind Share, Market Share, Channel Share, in all aspects of revenue management, sales, marketing, and operations.
* Chair the weekly revenue meeting for your assigned property(ies) to collaborate on revenue management, sales, and marketing strategy with the hotel and support teams. Ensure to understand the impact of decisions on operations and profitability.

* Ensure that our current systems and processes meet group requirements and are adjusted appropriately to support the business.
* Responsible for weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc data analysis and reporting.
* Identify and report on actions taken with regards to important trends (i.e. pace, group pace, booking window, booking channel, etc).

* Prepare annual hotel revenue budget and maintain ongoing results analysis.
* Prepare monthly forecasts with a daily breakdown of occupancy/rate and market segment mix along with ongoing results analysis.
* Monitor competitors’ products and revenue management practices. Also monitor new hotel development and local market demand generators.
* Maintain strong relationships with third\-party partners including OTA market managers.
* Oversee channel management including rate loading and inventory management.
* Responsible for the continued usage and maintenance of the revenue management system. Responsible for forecast validation and daily interaction with system and the decisions produced, configuration and maintenance tasks related to the system.

* You’re looking for a place where you can be you: no clones in suits for us.
* Just like us, you leave your ego at the door and help get things done.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way.

* The opportunity to work with an exciting new hospitality concept in Madrid and have a real impact on its success.

* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and building a portfolio of brands.

* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.

title: BALENCIAGA Assistant Store Manager
description:

Founded by Spanish\-born Cristóbal Balenciaga in 1917 and established in Paris in 1937, the original House of Balenciaga defined modern couture with its many innovations to form and technique.
  

  

Today it continues to uphold the vision of the House through boundary\-pushing collections including women’s and men’s ready\-to\-wear, accessories, and objets d’art. title: Facilities Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.


We are looking for a Facility Manager to oversee the maintenance and operation of our facilities and workplace services, ensuring they meet the needs of the organization and its employees.


Reporting to the Security Director, you will be based at our Madrid headquarters.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operation of LOEWE facilities, ensuring a safe, efficient, and high\-quality workplace environment.
* Oversee facility service providers and contracts, including security, cleaning, catering, parking, maintenance, and renovation projects.
* Lead facilities staff and external contractors, monitoring service performance, SLAs, KPIs, and cost efficiency.
* Manage facilities budgets, procurement activities, and operational expenditures.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and building regulations, including mandatory inspections, audits, risk assessments, and energy efficiency standards.
* Plan and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and building management systems (BMS).
* Coordinate office space planning, workplace moves, refurbishment projects, and facility\-related infrastructure requirements.
* Develop and implement workplace policies, procedures, and best practices to support business operations.
* Collaborate closely with HR, Finance, Legal, Procurement, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure integrated facility management.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives through the use of CAFM tools, digital maintenance platforms, and workplace analytics.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* 5 years of experience in facilities maintenance or equivalent related functions.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to lead and manage teams and projects.
* Attention to detail but also to see the implications for the bigger picture
* Commercial and customer service awareness
* Organisation, time management, prioritising and the ability to handle various things at the same time.
* Good knowledge of IT packages.
* Fluent Spanish and English is a must.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.  



If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director**

**Location:** **Madrid**

**Job Code:** *placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping*

**About DWS:**

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.


Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry\-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.


We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.


As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

title: Lifestyle Agent
description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
**Brand:** Avolta
  
  

**Country:**  

ES

WHO WE ARE
  
  

**At Avolta (SIX:** AVOL), our people are at the driving force behind our success. With a team of over 76,000 individuals representing more than 150 nationalities, we are a truly global company driven by passion, innovation, and excellence.
  
  

Avolta is the leading global travel retail and food \& beverage player, placing the traveler at the heart of everything we do. By combining travel retail, convenience and F\&B, we create integrated and innovative experiences across the traveler’s journey.
  
  

Our 77,000 team members deliver these experiences every day across more than 5,100 outlets in around 1,000 locations, including airports, motorways and other travel destinations, in over 70 countries.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
  

The Global Category Management Demand Planning Specialist supports the Produce category at a global level, driving accurate demand forecasting, sales and stock performance analysis, and effective inventory management across a luxury brands and stores. The role partners closely with Buying, Local Operations, and Finance to support seasonal Open‑to‑Buy (OTB) planning, optimize financial performance, manage stock risks, and improve forecasting accuracy through data‑driven insights and statistical modeling.
  
  

The role reports to the Global Category Management Planning \& Pricing Head and is based in Madrid, Spain.
  
  

RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Build and maintain sales and demand forecasts by brand, category, and store across short\-, mid\-, and long\-term planning horizons
  
Translate sales forecasts into seasonal Open\-to\-Buy (OTB), stock targets, and replenishment plans
  
Produce and analyze financial KPI reports covering sales, margin, stock positions, weeks of supply (WOS), service levels, ageing stock, and forecast accuracy
  
Generate dashboards and management reports to support weekly trade meetings, monthly reviews, and effective decision\-making
  
Partner with Buyers, Retail teams, Local Operations, and Finance to plan new launches, special projects, seasonal demand, and store openings
  
Monitor terminal, slow\-moving, ageing, and obsolete stock positions, proactively highlighting risks and opportunities
  
Recommend and support proactive stock actions, including replenishments, transfers, returns to vendor (RTVs), markdown proposals, liquidation programs, and outlet clearance plans
  
Propose cost initiatives and support provision accruals related to stock obsolescence, ensuring clearance targets are aligned with financial expectations
  
Manage Never\-Out\-of\-Stock (NOS) replenishment and support day\-to\-day demand control using statistical forecast models
  
Continuously improve demand planning models, dashboards, and stock management processes by leveraging historical trends, seasonality, and client behavior
  
  

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

1\-2 years of experience in demand planning, merchandising planning, inventory planning, supply chain planning, or a similar analytical role
  
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support business decision\-making
  
Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is considered an advantage
  
Exposure to forecasting, inventory management, replenishment, or retail planning processes is desirable
  
Experience with planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or similar tools) is a plus
  
Detail\-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with large datasets
  
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to different stakeholders
  
Collaborative, proactive, and eager to learn and develop within a fast\-paced retail environment
  
Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset

description:
**Company Description**  

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95\+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**  

We are currently seeking a People Operations Shared Service Specialist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, supporting our People Operations activities across France.


We are looking for someone with the right mindset above all, someone who is service\-oriented, solutions\-focused and proactive, with a genuine desire to anticipate the needs of People Managers and deliver a positive experience throughout the employee lifecycle.


In this role, you will provide first\-level People Operations support and guidance to Department Heads, responding to queries relating to HR and payroll policies, procedures and programmes. Queries will be managed through a ticketing system according to priority, with complex or sensitive matters escalated to the People Operations Business Partner for France, where appropriate.


You will provide comprehensive administrative support across the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and pre\-employment through to onboarding, employee changes and post\-hire administration. This will include, but is not limited to:

* Posting and closing vacancies through SmartRecruiters and Workday.
* Initiating and validating position and employee changes in Workday.
* Supporting the recruitment process and gathering feedback to help continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
* Managing a range of HR administration through Workday, the ATS and other People \& Culture systems and tools.
* Providing general HR and payroll administration support.

**Onboarding \& Employee Experience**


You will work closely with Department Heads to ensure a smooth, engaging and positive onboarding experience for new colleagues.


This will include:

* Preparing and sending onboarding documentation.
* Reviewing and validating required forms to ensure compliance and appropriate benefits setup.
* Configuring onboarding workflows and ensuring relevant information and access are in place within Workday.
* Supporting new hire communications and announcements.
* Gathering feedback and identifying opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Performance Management**


Support the administration and coordination of the performance management process, working closely with the People Operations Business Partner for France and the HRIS team.

**HR Administration \& Compliance**


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and HR documentation, ensuring compliance with legal requirements, RHG standards, processes and appropriate authorisation protocols.


Provide additional support across benefits administration, leave management and other People Operations activities as required.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**


Work closely with the People Operations Business Partner and the wider People Operations Shared Services team to deliver an efficient, consistent and high\-quality service.


You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the employee and manager experience and enhance the way People Operations services are delivered.

 **Qualifications**  

* Previous experience in Human Resources, People Operations, personnel administration, training and development, or a similar role.
* Experience within the hospitality or wider service industry is highly desirable.
* Good understanding of HR and payroll processes, policies and best practices.
* Experience using Workday, SmartRecruiters or similar HRIS/ATS platforms would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong communication and customer service skills, with a proactive and solutions\-focused approach.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisation and confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work to deadlines and adapt to a fast\-paced and changing environment without compromising quality.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the confidence to know when an issue requires escalation.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?  

  

Live the Magic of Hospitality \- Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.  

  

Build a Great Career \- No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development, helping you reach your full potential.  

  

Experience the Team Spirit \- Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.  

  

Lead with Your Ambition \- Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain**

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.


**Job Description**

This is a **hybrid** role. As a **Marketing Administration Executive** , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day running of marketing operations across France, Spain and Portugal. Acting as the backbone of the regional marketing team, you will coordinate key administrative processes, manage budgets and supplier payments, support compliance requirements, and help ensure marketing activity is delivered efficiently and in line with internal processes.


Reporting to the **Head of Southwestern Europe** , you will be part of the **Southwestern Europe Marketing Team** , who are responsible for developing and delivering local marketing strategies and campaigns across France, Spain and Portugal. The team works closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to drive growth, strengthen brand presence and deliver impactful customer experiences across multiple markets. This role plays a vital part in supporting the operational effectiveness of the team and ensuring marketing activity can be executed seamlessly.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-paced international marketing team, where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple functions and markets. You'll have the chance to make a tangible impact by improving processes, supporting key stakeholders, and helping the team operate effectively. If you're highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoy being at the centre of a busy, collaborative environment, **could this be the perfect next step for you?**

You Will:


* Coordinate the creation, tracking and renewal of marketing contracts, ensuring the correct approval processes are followed and records are maintained accurately.
* Raise and track purchase orders across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring spend aligns with approved budgets and supplier requirements.
* Process and monitor marketing invoices, working closely with suppliers, Finance and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support timely payments.
* Maintain budget trackers, reconciliations and reporting updates, providing marketing teams with accurate visibility of committed and actual spend.
* Support procurement and supplier onboarding activities by coordinating required information, following up approvals and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Coordinate marketing\-related compliance information requirements across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring information is collected, organised and submitted on time.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, records and trackers, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and up to date.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the regional marketing team, including meeting coordination, supplier follow\-up, document preparation and process management.
* Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and external partners to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of marketing operations.

**Qualifications**

You Have:


* Works carefully and accurately, checking details before sharing information or moving a process forward.
* Plans work clearly, keeps trackers up to date and follows through on agreed actions.
* Collaborates well with colleagues across different markets and functions, adapting communication to the person and situation.
* Asks questions early when something is unclear and follows the right approval routes.
* Responds calmly to changing priorities and helps others understand what is needed to keep work moving.
* Looks for simple improvements that make recurring administration easier, clearer and more consistent.

**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire you. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:


* A regular bonus and great pension.
* €9\.60 food vouchers per day.
* 25 days annual leave
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

\#LI\-PA1


***TAG Heuer***
**MAISON**
--------------------------

1860, Saint\-Imier at the very heart of the birthplace of watchmaking. A young ambitious watchmaker decides to found his own brand. His name: Edouard Heuer. At just 20 years old, he was to revolutionize the watchmaking industry by breaking away from the established rules. Ever since that time, TAG Heuer’s vocation has been to push back the boundaries and defy convention to invent incredible watches and chronographs of extreme precision. The invention of the oscillating pinion in 1887 exemplified this spirit, streamlining the chronograph’s design and enhancing its responsiveness—a principle that underpins our engineering philosophy even today. Then came the 1916 Mikrograph, the first stopwatch accurate to 1/100th of a second, cementing TAG Heuer's reputation as the precision timekeeper in competitive sports. Indeed, the world of TAG Heuer is intimately linked to motor racing and the division of time into infinitely small units, but its aura extends well beyond this arena. description:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Business School** is looking for a **Media Lab Technician** to join its team!

The **Media Lab Technician** primarily supports BCDM and MCDB students and faculty activity, but will also serve some of the audiovisual needs of Masters and Executive Masters Programs such as the MSMC and the ESMC, in addition to content Creation to the IEU Comms Lab and the pilot project of the BCDM Agency Incubator.  

The **Media Lab Technician** is responsible for coordinating the Media Lab Studios and facilities, maintaining an inventory of video and audio production equipment, providing software and desktop user support to Students within the Media Lab facilities at IE University Campuses in Madrid at IE Tower and María de Molina. **Why IE University?**


Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

  



**Our Purpose**


To foster positive change.

  



**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset


We are looking for a person to join a full\-time position in **Madrid \- María de Molina.**

Equipment Circulation and technical support:* Manage new and existing video and post\-production equipment for student and faculty use.
* Provide Media Lab users with technical support and training necessary to accomplish academic and research\-related tasks.
* Maintain and service cameras, tripods, lighting kits, audio gear, expendables and other production accessories.

* Keep the camera and sound equipment batteries charged and SD cards empty.
* Check the camera status before class sessions held at the Media Lab studios as well as before and after borrowing equipment to students.
* Check studios status before and after students / professors use them.

* Delete obsolete or inappropriate files, programs and viruses on all computers.
* Update software and operating systems as needed.

* Keep a data base of best student productions

  

Coordination and support in the MediaLab led initiatives* Support the MediaLab director in the coordination of the MediaLab Film Challenge
* Give technical support to the Workshops organized by the MediaLab director with professionals of the AV field
