* Passion for content creation, curiosity about the latest trends in the Media and Entertainment and AI sectors, and above all, team spirit and a drive to be a mentor to young students and professionals.
* Ability and interest in working in a liberal\-arts educational context, with students and instructors who have a wide range of technical skill levels, in a range of pedagogical contexts.
* Working knowledge of and ability to instruct students on the following: : DSLR \& mirrorless camera operation for photography and video recording, audio recording, lighting for camera photography, video editing, post\-production basics and basic roles for a film production crew.
* Working knowledge of 2D with Adobe After Effects is a plus.
* Working knowledge of and ability to instruct students on best practices for media management, organization, video compression, codecs, file types, and current trends in digital media. Experience as instructor or teacher in Workshops, seminars or masterclasses is a plus.
* Ability to instruct students on best practices for equipment use, files organization, video compression, codecs, file types, and current trends in digital media.
* Strong creativity and problem\-solving skills to apply principles, practices, and procedures within discipline to complete difficult assignments.
* Bachelor Degree or equivalent in Media Production/ Content Production. A Masters Degree in related Audiovisual field is a plus

Unleash your full potential and make an impact. The next move is yours!  

If you want to be part of this educational revolution, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team at **IE University.**

description:

---------------


If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/  

  

About Us:  

  

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  

  

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. About the Role:  

  

The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) supports the ongoing success of creators across the Twitch Partner program and plays a vital role in bringing new creators into the ecosystem. This role spans Creator Recruitment, Account Management, and Community Engagement, requiring a balance of analytical thinking and relationship management skills.  

  

The role will work from Madrid, Spain and report into the Director of Global Spanish Partnerships.  

  

You Will:  

  

Creator Recruitment  

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to high\-potential creators who are new to Twitch or transitioning to livestreaming
* Guide creators through structured onboarding covering analytics, audience development, channel setup, and monetization fundamentals, support.
* Conduct stream reviews and support test\-streaming to ensure smooth creator starts
* Maintain visibility in emerging creator communities across platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, etc.

  

Partner Touchpoints \& Account Management
  

* Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of Twitch Partners
* Provide timely, high\-quality support and guidance on Twitch products, policies, and best practices
* Maintain accurate documentation of creator interactions and portfolio data in Salesforce
* Collect and log partner feedback to inform product development and messaging
* Community Management \& Events (15% of time)
* Support planning and execution of IRL events to deepen creator relationships
* Maintain active presence in Partner community spaces (e.g., Discord)
* Represent Twitch at creator community moments as a brand ambassador
* Document creator insights and event outcomes

  

Administrative \& Strategic Tasks  

* Generate and maintain reports on creator performance and engagement
* Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities within creator portfolio
* Participate in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives
* Support development of scalable solutions for creator needs

  

Team Collaboration  

* Work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and other teams
* Participate in regular team meetings and planning sessions
* Share insights and best practices with broader partnerships team
* Contribute to process improvements and team initiatives

  

Success Metrics  

* Creator recruitment and onboarding targets
* Partner retention and satisfaction rates
* Response time and quality of support
* Event participation and outcomes
* Documentation quality and timeliness
* Cross\-functional collaboration effectiveness

  

Perks  

* Private Medical Insurance
* Dental, Vision \& Life Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Maternity \& Parental Leave
* Paid Time Off \& Holidays
* Commuter Benefits
* Amazon Employee Discount

  

About the team  

The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in client/partner management, content acquisition, or related fields
* Demonstrated experience in relationship management and business development
* Strong analytical and communication skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in digital media, gaming, or creator economy
* Knowledge of content creation platforms and livestreaming industry
* Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)
* Project management experience
* Additional language skills relevant to the region

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

Growth is the team responsible for driving Fever's content portfolio across all verticals and markets, ensuring the successful execution of the company's business plan.  

We act as strategic consultants, supporting both our partners and in\-house projects to achieve their performance goals, while working closely with external and internal stakeholders.  

Our decisions are data\-driven at every level, from strategy to execution, enabling us to deeply understand Fever's business model and collaborate effectively across teams to guide the company's growth in the right direction.

* Partner with Cinema GM, taking full responsibility for its growth strategy and performance
* Define and implement new growth strategies to improve key business metrics and enhance overall company performance
* Lead high\-impact, end\-to\-end projects and initiatives
* Collaborate with teams and stakeholders across international markets
* Report directly to the Global Growth Director, working closely with top management and founders

* 8\+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, marketing or business\-related roles
* Deep understanding of core growth strategies, including but not limited to email, push/SMS and social
* Entertainment marketing experience and knowledge of theatrical, home entertainment or gaming
* Proven track record of building trust and effectively leading teams or key projects
* You have an Engineering bachelor's (Civil, Industrial, Telecommunications, or Aeronautics) or a Maths / Statistics / Data Analytics / Strategy background
* Strong data\-driven mindset: you use numbers to inform strategic and business decisions
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work successfully across multiple disciplines and business areas
* Advanced English level; additional languages are a plus
* Hands\-on, proactive, and solution\-oriented
* Experience managing teams of skilled professionals

* Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth

description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.
* **Drive change management and adoption of new ways of working**
* Lead change readiness, stakeholder impact assessment, adoption planning, and reinforcement for procurement tools, processes, digital solutions, and AI\-enabled use cases where relevant.
* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, resistance, confusion, or capability gaps, and drive practical actions to address them.
* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.
* **Track progress and drive continuous improvement**
* Track simple, meaningful indicators for learning participation, adoption, capability uplift, and business impact where measurable.
* Use feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to continuously improve learning content, adoption support, and the overall user experience.
* Partner with global L\&D operations to manage learning logistics, platform activities, and reporting with clear ownership and follow\-through.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


* Master’s degree preferred; relevant certification in change management, learning and development, project/program management, or procurement is an advantage.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Procurement in a global corporate environment; experience with AI Transformations, supporting program communications, change management, procurement transformation, learning enablement, or functional capability programs is highly preferred
* Ability to create clear communication plans and support change readiness, impact assessment, adoption planning, reinforcement, and measurement for new ways of working.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, audience\-relevant messages.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled technologies, data, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, learning technologies, and communication asset creation tools.
**Also Good to Have**
---------------------


* Experience in program communications, change management, stakeholder engagement, capability building, or learning enablement within a global corporate or functional environment.
* Practical understanding of communication and change management activities, including readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, reinforcement, and measurement.
* Strong communication, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and tailor messages for different audiences.
* A practical, delivery\-oriented mindset, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional initiatives, manage change activities, and turn plans into clear actions.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled solutions, data\-driven ways of working, and technology\-enabled business transformation, including the ability to translate technology change into practical user adoption support.
* Ability to create engaging transformation assets and internal branding materials that make complex programs feel coherent, accessible, and easy to adopt across a global audience.
* Procurement, learning academy, digital adoption, change network, or learning platform experience would be an advantage.
**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------


At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. The Global Communication Specialist supports the delivery of ALS' global communication strategy by developing and delivering high\-quality internal and external communication that strengthens the ALS brand, protects its reputation and supports business priorities.


Based in Europe, the role extends the capability of the Global Communication team across time zones, strengthening connections across the business and supporting the consistent delivery of global communication.


Working closely with the Group Communication Director and Senior Global Communication Specialist, the role works with stakeholders across the business to support communication strategies, develop engaging content and deliver communication plans that align with ALS' strategic objectives .


The role works with a high degree of autonomy in day\-to\-day delivery while operating within established communication strategies, governance frameworks and agreed priorities.


As a member of the Global Communication team, the role contributes to a consistent, coordinated approach across regions, ensuring communication activities are aligned, audience focused and delivered to a high standard.


**Key responsibilities**

Strategic communication


* Support the development and delivery of communication strategies for global business initiatives
* Support the translation of business priorities into communication plans and delivery activities
* Provide communication advice to stakeholders within established communication frameworks
* Identify communication risks and escalate matters where appropriate
* Monitor communication outcomes and identify opportunities for improvements
* Apply ALS' communications policies, governance and brand standards across all communication activities.
Internal communication


* Manage assigned global communication programs and initiatives, taking responsibility for planning, delivery and stakeholder coordination.
* Develop employee communication, leadership messages, presentations, intranet content and communication toolkits
* Support global communication programs, including organisational change, employee engagement initiatives, leadership communication and business updates
* Ensure messaging is consistent across regions and aligned with ALS' strategic priorities.
External communication


* Develop media materials, corporate messaging, website content, social media copy and client communication
* Support reputation management and corporate affairs activities
* Assist with issues and crisis communication as required .
Content development


* Produce clear, engaging and accurate communication for a wide range of audiences
* Translate technical or complex information into accessible language
* Maintain a consistently high standard of writing, editing and proofreading , ensuring consistency and alignment with ALS’ messaging and positioning

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

As a **Principal Security \& Detection Engineer** , you will provide senior technical leadership across our Security Operations capability, with a particular focus on **detection engineering, security research, SOC automation, threat hunting, and the continued development of our fraud monitoring platform** .  



  

  

This is a highly technical role for an individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and taking ownership of complex technical problems from concept through to implementation.


You will operate as a senior member of the technical leadership team, helping define the direction of our detection and research capabilities while continuing to work hands\-on across security engineering, software development, research and automation.

* Vulnerability research and exploitation
* Network security and networking technologies
* Python
* SQL
APIs and system integrations  
*

title: Customer Success Manager - Madrid (F/M/X)
description:
Madrid  

Permanent contract · Start date: ASAP  

International environment

**Do you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and building things from scratch?**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Combo, we're looking for our next **Customer Success Manager to take care of our Spanish market**.


Spain is a strategic market for Combo. We already have an established local Sales team and a growing customer base. Our next challenge is to continue structuring our Customer Success approach while ensuring our Spanish customers get the support and experience they need to succeed with Combo.


This is a highly hands\-on and operational role.


You won't simply manage a portfolio of customers. You'll take ownership of their overall experience: from supporting key accounts to handling day\-to\-day requests, while also building scalable processes that will allow us to grow.

**More than 150,000 employees use Combo every day.**
----------------------------------------------------


To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.


At Combo, we build HR solutions for companies with deskless teams: restaurants, hotels, retailers, pharmacies, bakeries, sports and leisure businesses, and more.


The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

**This role is made for you if...**
-----------------------------------


You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.


When something isn't working perfectly, your first instinct is to understand the situation and find a practical solution.


You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


You care about the quality of your work, especially when it comes to customer follow\-up and data. For you, keeping a clean and reliable CRM isn't just a detail.


You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**A gross annual fixed salary between €34K and €41K**, depending on your experience.


And also:

* **Stock options** once your probation period has been successfully completed
* ️ **Meal vouchers**
* **A 40\-hour working week**
* A role based in our **Madrid office**
* An international environment, working closely with teams in France
* A high\-impact role with real ownership over a strategic market and customer base
* ️ The opportunity to build, structure, and improve the way we support our customers in Spain
* A close\-knit local Sales team, backed by an established and growing European scale\-up
* Plenty of autonomy and room to make an impact

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

**Step 1 – HR Screening (30 min)**


A first conversation with **Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager**, to get to know each other, tell you more about Combo, and discuss your experience and expectations.

**Step 2 – Management Fit (60 min)**


A conversation with **Estelle, Head of Customer Success**, to discuss the role in more detail, your experience, and how you approach Customer Success and customer management.

**Step 3 – Skill Test**


A practical exercise designed to better understand how you approach real\-life situations you could face in the role.

**Step 4 – Culture Fit**


A final meeting at our **Madrid office**, where you'll get to meet the team and learn more about how we work at Combo.

**Our commitment**
------------------


At Combo, we believe diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create stronger companies.


We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

title: Director of Real Estate
description:
**OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE**

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.


**HOW WE SHOW UP**

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.


We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.


**ROLE SUMMARY**  

The Director, Real Estate is the driving force behind CorePower Yoga's real estate growth strategy and the ongoing health of our existing portfolio. This role owns annual market planning and site selection strategy, leads a team who does negotiations for new deals and lease renewals, and manages a portfolio of 213 studios including renewals, relocations, and closures. As the quarterback of every new deal, the Director partners closely with Design, Construction, outside brokers, and landlords to take sites from initial identification through grand opening. This is a highly analytical, relationship\-driven role that requires the ability to translate market data into a compelling growth story for executive leadership, while also serving as a passionate ambassador for the CorePower Yoga brand and the benefits of a yoga\-centered lifestyle. The Director will lead and develop a team of three direct reports. CorePower Yoga anticipates growing at 25\+ new studios/year into coming years.  



**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIE** **S**

**Growth Strategy \& Market Planning**

* Lead annual market planning process, identifying and prioritizing target markets and trade areas aligned with CorePower Yoga's growth objectives.
* Own delivery against annual growth commitments, including new studio openings, relocations, and portfolio optimization targets
* Develop and maintain a data\-driven site selection framework, incorporating demographic, lifestyle, and competitive analysis.
* Present market plans, growth pipelines, and portfolio performance to executive leadership on a regular cadence.
* Strong Financial acumen including navigating proformas, studio level financials and financial terms for deal trade offs with ease.

**Portfolio Management**

* Manage the full 213\-studio portfolio, proactively evaluating each location's performance and lease position.
* Lead lease renewal strategy and negotiations across the portfolio, balancing financial performance with brand and market presence.
* Identify and execute studio relocations and closures where warranted by market, financial, or lease conditions.
* Create and maintain standardized templates and playbooks for LOIs, leases, and market plans to drive consistency and efficiency across the team.

**Deal Execution \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the quarterback for all new deals, from site identification and underwriting through lease execution, construction, and grand opening.
* Negotiate letters of intent and lease agreements directly with landlords and brokers, securing terms that support long\-term studio profitability.
* Partner closely with Design and Construction teams to ensure sites are delivered on time, on budget, and true to the CorePower Yoga brand experience.
* Manage relationships with a network of outside brokers and landlords, representing CorePower Yoga as a preferred tenant and partner.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of direct reports, setting clear priorities and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture.
* Build team capabilities in market analysis, deal negotiation, and portfolio management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7–10 years of real estate experience within a multi\-unit, multi\-location retail, restaurant, or fitness brand.
* Proven track record managing a large studio/store portfolio, including lease renewals, relocations, and closures.
* Demonstrated success leading site selection and market planning for a growing brand.
* Strong lease negotiation experience, with direct dealings with landlords and brokers.
* Highly analytical, with the ability to gather, synthesize, and present complex data to executive leadership.
* Experience managing and developing a team; strong people\-leadership skills.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills — able to bring the CorePower Yoga brand and the benefits of yoga to life for external partners.
* Comfortable operating cross\-functionally with Design, Construction, Finance, and Operations.
* Bachelor's degree required

Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40%.  

* 

  

**COMPENSATION**

* Annual Salary: $135,000\-$150,000 based on experience
20% Bonus  
* 

  

**WORK LOCATION**

* Remote working opportunity. Must reside in a state with current CorePower Yoga operations

**THE PERKS**

* Free All Access Membership \- use anytime, in studio or online
* Free All Access Membership for a Plus One \- bring someone along!
* Retail Discounts
* Continued Education Offerings
* Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Comprehensive Health Insurance \- available for eligible employees
* Generous PTO Policy
* Expanded Holiday Calendar
* Quarterly Wellness Days

WHO WE ARE


At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life\-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on\-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.  



As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
#### **In a nutshell**

 **Title:** Head of Marketing  

**Location:** Fully Remote within UK or US  

**Travel:** Up to 20%
  

**Days/week:** Full Time

#### **The Who, What, Where, When \& Why**


We're hiring a Head of Marketing to be the commercial\-strategist and editorial owner for OMS marketing across the UK and US. You'll own positioning, product marketing, thought leadership, events and sales alignment.

**Where things stand today**

* ICPs and buyer personas are defined across UK Academia, US Academia and US Health Systems.
* Messaging architecture is built and being rolled into sales enablement.
* First campaigns are running through an external agency, developed in\-house.

**Extensive, hands\-on AI experience is essential for this role**, not a nice\-to\-have. You'll personally direct, edit and quality\-control AI\-produced content and outreach, and own the standards that decide what's good enough to reach a customer. If you don't already work this way, this isn't the right role for you.

#### **What You'll Own**

**Campaign Execution (UK \& US)**

* Drive end\-to\-end execution of the marketing campaign calendar across both regions: ABM, paid, organic, email, content, events.
* Manage our external campaign agency as the in\-house counterpart: brief, review, push back, raise quality, hold timelines.
* Own day\-to\-day campaign performance \- what's working, what to kill, what to double down on \- and report into the executive team weekly.

**Content \& Asset Production**

* Produce and ship high\-quality marketing assets at pace: web copy, landing pages, case studies, white papers, sales collateral, social content, email sequences.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) as core production infrastructure \- directing, editing, and quality\-controlling AI\-assisted output to a standard that reads as authored, not generated.
* Translate clinical outcomes, customer stories, and product capability into commercially compelling proof points.

**ABM \& Demand Execution**

* Execute account\-based plays against named US health systems, NHS trusts and university nursing programs on both sides of the Atlantic, using the ICP and persona definitions already in place.
* Run the marketing tech stack day\-to\-day (HubSpot core; ABM and intent tooling as we scale it).
* Partner closely with Sales, Account Management and Success to make sure marketing programs land where the pipeline needs them.

**Events**

* Own execution of our priority events in the US and UK.
* Drive everything from pre\-event ABM, on\-site presence, and post\-event follow\-up. Measure pipeline contribution, not booth traffic.

**Customer Marketing**

* Turn reference customers into commercial leverage through case studies, reference calls, co\-marketed content, and advocacy.

**Operating Rhythm**

* Set and run the marketing operating rhythm: weekly campaign reviews, monthly performance reporting, quarterly planning against pipeline targets set by the CEO and Sales.
* Manage the marketing budget day\-to\-day and hold agencies and vendors accountable to it.

#### **What You Bring**

* 5\-8\+ years in B2B marketing, including senior ownership of positioning, product marketing and editorial strategy inside a SaaS or healthtech environment selling enterprise deals.
* Extensive, current, hands\-on AI experience is essential: you use Claude and modern AI tooling as core production infrastructure, and you have direct experience setting quality bars and review workflows for AI\-generated content.
* Experience marketing into healthcare, clinical education, workforce or nursing.
* Exposure to both UK and US B2B markets
* A proven, senior\-level editorial eye \- you can personally rewrite a weak headline or tighten a report, and know the difference between good and merely fluent.
* Demonstrable experience owning product marketing and competitive positioning, not just executing campaigns against someone else's brief.
* Comfort owning a budget and managing people and/or a flex pool of contractors and agencies.
* Familiarity with the modern B2B marketing stack: HubSpot, LinkedIn paid, intent and ABM tooling, basic analytics.
* Track record of operating as a senior individual contributor and small\-team lead rather than as a full time people manager \- and being energised by that.
* Experience working alongside a defined GTM strategy rather than setting one from scratch.

#### **About Oxford Medical Simulation**


OMS helps health systems, hospitals, medical and nursing schools deliver training and assessment better, cheaper, faster and at scale.


Our award\-winning simulation platform is transforming the way healthcare and educational institutions train, assess and recruit healthcare professionals. By combining cutting edge 3D visualisation with artificial intelligence and leading educational theory, OMS delivers all of the benefits of physical simulation whilst delivering significant savings and improving patient care.


Since launching the award\-winning OMS Platform in 2018, we've grown fast \- partnering with over 150 leading healthcare institutions worldwide. From Oxford University and NYU to Mayo Clinic and the NHS, even the world’s top pediatric hospital use OMS. We’re helping transform healthcare training with immersive, on\-demand clinical simulation


Oxford Medical Simulation is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Oxford Medical Simulation is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

#### **Who we are**


We are Skiers / Boarders, Runners, Rowers, Pilots, Magicians, Weavers, Photographers, Game heroes, Movie Buffs, and every other variety of people. We are hard working. We are passionate about what we do. We care about the work. We care about each other. We care about pushing the envelope and we care about using our working lives to make the world a better place.


We value these behaviours above all:

* Care \& Pride \- we take care and pride in everything we do
* Growth mindset \- we push the boundaries so we are adaptive, inventive and always learning
* One Team \- we are in it together, mucking in and supporting each other with humour and humility


Sound like you?

#### **Benefits**

* 38 days annual leave (incl. Public holidays)
* Private Medical Insurance
* Flexible work environment \- work from home/ remote first
* Pension: 3% company and 5% individual contribution
* £500 one\-off office set up allowance
* High specification work laptop and VR headset
* Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
* Knowing that you are making a real difference!


If you have any questions please contact our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager: victoria@oxfordmedicalsimulation.com


As part of our hiring process, we are unable to provide individual feedback on interviews. We appreciate your understanding and interest in OMS.


Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our careers page, which you can access via the Apply button on LinkedIn or directly through our website. **We will not be accepting CVs via email or LinkedIn messages.**

title: Paid Media Director
description:
**Who We Are**

  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
  

  

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side\-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  

  

Are you ready to make your impact?


**About The Role**


Our Corporate Positioning \& Insights (CPI\&I) practice is seeking a Paid Media Director to develop and execute paid media and digital strategy based on data\-driven insights. This role will be an important contributor to accounts covering ongoing corporate brand positioning, public affairs campaigns, crisis response and special situations.


In this role, the candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with clients across a range of sectors, as a key contributor to strategy and delivery, as well as helping to position our firm through thought leadership and contributions to generating new business. The role will develop in\-depth knowledge of client objectives and challenges and bring expertise in paid media strategy to bear on fast\-moving, news\-shaping client engagements.


**What You’ll Do**


Paid Media Strategy \& Execution


* Lead the end\-to\-end management of paid media campaigns across channels including paid search (Google, Bing, ChatGPT), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X/Twitter), programmatic display, video/CTV, and out of home from briefing through to post\-campaign analysis.
* Translate client business objectives and communications strategies into actionable paid media plans, including audience segmentation, channel selection, budget allocation, and KPI frameworks.
* Conceptualize and oversee creative concepting and copy requirements for paid activations, collaborating with creative and content colleagues to ensure messaging alignment.
* Own campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes to ensure accurate tracking and attribution across all paid programs.
* Manage campaign budgets with rigor, maintaining pacing reports and proactively flagging optimization opportunities or risks to senior team members and clients.

Client \& Account Management


* Serve as a primary day\-to\-day client contact on paid media accounts, communicating clearly and proactively with clients on campaign status, performance, and strategic direction.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with colleagues across Corporate Positioning \& Insights and wider Strategic Communications practices—including public affairs, financial communications, crisis management and corporate reputation—to deliver integrated, multi\-channel communications programs.
* Contribute to the development of client scopes, proposals, and presentations, articulating paid media strategy and measurement frameworks to senior audiences.
* Support new business development efforts by contributing paid media expertise to pitches and credential documents.

Team \& Practice Development


* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts and associates, reviewing their work and supporting their development in paid media craft.
* Contribute to Corporate Positioning \& Insights' internal knowledge\-sharing, staying current on platform updates, industry tools, and emerging best practices and disseminating insights to the broader team.
* Assist in establishing and refining team processes, workflow standards, and quality\-control frameworks for paid media delivery.

**How You’ll Grow**


We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development. We have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on\-the\-job learning, self\-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth. As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.


**What You Will Need To Succeed**


Basic Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Political Science, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on paid media experience, ideally within a communications agency, public affairs firm, or digital consultancy.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing paid campaigns across paid search (Google Ads), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), and programmatic display platforms.
* Proficiency in campaign measurement and analytics tools, including Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and native platform reporting.
* Experience with listening and monitoring tools such as Brandwatch, Meltwater and Signal AI, with proficiency in building queries using Boolean logic and establishing dashboards for reputation tracking.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data sets into clear, client\-ready narrative and recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines simultaneously in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes environment.
* Ability to travel to FTI office(s) and client site as needed
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer on a full\-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience in B2B or public affairs paid media, including issue advocacy, corporate reputation, or financial communications campaigns.
* Familiarity with DSPs and programmatic buying platforms.
* Experience with CTV/OTT media planning and buying.
* Working knowledge of data visualization and dashboarding tools
* Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or other relevant platform certifications.
* Experience with audience research, social listening, and media intelligence tools (e.g., Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr).
* Familiarity with SEO, search strategy, AI\-powered search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and evolving digital discovery trends.
* Exposure to A/B and multivariate creative testing methodologies.

title: Director, Creative Services - Pottery Barn
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Photo Direction Team**
 Housed within Pottery Barn’s Creative department, the Photo Direction team translates the brand’s creative
   

  

 vision into compelling photography and videography that inspires our customers to decorate, entertain, and
   

  

 live beautifully in a home that reflects their individual style.
   

  

 Supporting Pottery Barn’s omni\-channel business, the team concepts, develops and executes the photographic vision for each season, creating beautiful, distinctive and consistently on\-brand imagery across digital, social, print, marketing, advertising and in\-store channels. We foster a highly collaborative, creative and positive environment and partner closely across Creative, Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Video and Social Media.
   

  

**Overview Of The Creative Director Role**
 The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for driving and creating Pottery Barn’s seasonal
   

  

 photographic vision, ensuring that the brand’s visual expression is distinctive, inspiring and consistent
   

  

 across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 Working closely with the Senior Vice President of Creative and Vice President of Creative and Photography,
   

  

 the Creative Director translates brand, product and seasonal direction into compelling visual concepts and
   

  

 establishes the creative framework that guides photography, video and related content.
   

  

 This role sees the big picture and is also responsible for executing the details. You are a
   

  

 sophisticated visual storyteller with a strong point of view on interiors, decorating, photography, styling and
   

  

 culture—and understand where Pottery Barn sits in that intersection.
   

  

 You also understand how to translate product and brand ideas into imagery that creates emotion,
   

  

 communicates a clear point of view and ultimately builds desire for the Pottery Barn brand. You have the ability to
   

  

 create compelling individual images while simultaneously knowing how to create cohesive images that form a campaign.
   

  

 The Creative Director leads and inspires Art Directors and extended creative teams while partnering with
   

  

 photographers, stylists, producers, set designers and cross\-functional leaders to bring seasonal campaigns
   

  

 and ongoing brand storytelling to life.
   

  

 You will report to the Vice President, Creative and Photography and work closely with the Senior Vice
   

  

 President of Creative.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with the SVP and VP of Creative to establish the overarching photographic and visual direction for seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives and key storytelling moments.
* Participate in seasonal concept showroom walk\-throughs and Product Development meetings to understand the product vision, key stories and priorities for each season.
* Translate seasonal product and brand direction into a clear creative vision that establishes the overall mood, storytelling approach, visual language and photographic point of view.
* With oversight from Vice President, Creative and Photography, lead the development and review of seasonal Creative Briefs, ensuring concepts reflect the intended brand vision and provide clear direction for Art Directors, photographers, stylists, producers and other creative partners.
* Establish and maintain Pottery Barn's photographic standards and overall visual "look and feel," ensuring consistency while continually evolving the brand's imagery.
* Provide creative leadership across multiple campaigns, shoots and seasonal chapters, maintaining a holistic view of how individual assets work together to create a cohesive customer experience.
* Guide Art Directors in developing decorating concepts, styling direction, camera approaches, lighting, set design and other visual elements that bring the approved creative direction to life.
* Partner with the VP Creative on photographer, stylist and creative talent selection based on the needs and visual objectives of each campaign.
* Review and guide set concepts and environmental storytelling to ensure rooms and spaces communicate a strong Pottery Barn point of view and appropriately showcase product.
* Provide senior\-level creative direction during key photography and video shoots, guiding mood, tone, composition, lighting, styling and overall visual execution.
* Inspire and develop Art Directors and broader creative teams, providing clear feedback, mentorship and creative guidance while fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Build productive creative partnerships with photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other external and internal creative talent.
* Partner closely with Merchandising and Product Development to ensure creative storytelling and product representation are aligned while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.
* Collaborate with E\-Commerce, Social, Video, Marketing and other channel partners to ensure the photographic vision translates effectively across customer touchpoints.
* Partner with Pagination and Creative teams to ensure imagery supports compelling layouts, storytelling and seasonal content needs.
* Review photography and video throughout the creative process, providing senior\-level direction on image selection, color, retouching, backgrounds, cropping, layouts and overall visual consistency.
* Anticipate creative challenges and proactively identify solutions that balance brand vision, product priorities, production realities and business needs.
* Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, curiosity and excellence while helping evolve Pottery Barn's visual expression and brand relevance.


**Criteria**
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in a visual or creative discipline such as advertising, interior design, interior architecture, graphic design, fine art or photography.
* Significant progressive creative leadership experience within photography, art direction, styling, editorial, advertising or related visual disciplines.
* Deep experience within home furnishings, lifestyle, interiors, retail, editorial or a similarly design\-driven industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate an overarching creative vision and translate brand\-level concepts into compelling visual storytelling.
* Exceptional visual judgment with a sophisticated understanding of interiors, decorating, styling, composition, photography, color and design.
* Proven ability to lead, inspire and develop Art Directors and multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Experience directing photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other creative partners.
* Strong conceptual thinker who can move fluidly between high\-level creative strategy and detailed visual execution.
* Ability to articulate creative ideas clearly and persuasively to creative teams, cross\-functional partners and senior executives.
* Highly collaborative, with demonstrated success partnering across Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Social, Video and other functions.
* Resourceful and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple creative initiatives and changing priorities while maintaining a consistently high visual standard.
* Strong understanding of the home furnishings and décor landscape with knowledge of current and emerging trends in interiors, photography, design and culture.
* Proven proficiency working within a digital\-first creative environment, including familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and contemporary creative workflows.
* Above all, you bring exceptional taste, strong creative instincts and a clear point of view, paired with the leadership skills to inspire others and translate Pottery Barn's brand vision into imagery that feels relevant, beautiful and unmistakably Pottery Barn.


**Our Culture \& Values**
 We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.
   

  

**People First**
 Putting People First means investing in overall well\-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:
   

  

**Benefits**
* A generous discount on all WSI brands
* A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
* Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
* Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same\-sex domestic partner benefits

**Continued Learning**
* In\-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University

 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H\-1B or other employment\-based immigration).
   

  

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.
   

  

 Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.
   

  

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $140,000\-$175,000\. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.
   

  

**About Us**
 Our Company
   

  

 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark \& Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully\-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick\-and\-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high\-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi\-brand, multi\-channel, global enterprise supported by state\-of\-the\-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing \- and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

title: Principal Clinical Research Analyst - Class III Medical Devices (EU MDR Clinical Affairs Expert) 1
description:
Director, Quality Assurance

  



BIOTRONIK is one of the leading manufacturers of cardio and endovascular implants and catheters for cardiac rhythm management, electrophysiology and vascular intervention. As a globally active company headquartered in Berlin, Germany, we develop, produce and distribute high\-quality medical products based on the latest technology and research. Our success is based on the competence and results\-oriented cooperation of our employees.

  



California Research Center Electrophysiology, Inc (CRC EP, Inc.), a Biotronik business unit located in Tustin, CA, develops pulsed\-field cardiac ablation (PFA) technologies. The team has recently completed the First\-in\-Human clinical trial which validated the company’s PFA technology for treatment of atrial fibrillation. The team is embarking on preparing the technology for regulatory approvals followed by commercial release in respective territories. We are continually looking for talented engineers, scientists, and professionals to share in our mission.

  


We are seeking a highly experienced **Principal Clinical Research Analyst** to provide strategic leadership and technical expertise in clinical evaluation, clinical evidence generation, and regulatory compliance for Class III medical devices. The ideal candidate will possess more than 7 years of experience in clinical affairs, clinical research, and regulatory support within the medical device industry, with extensive expertise in the requirements of the European Union Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745\). This role will serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for clinical evaluation and evidence strategies, partnering closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Engineering teams to ensure clinical compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Clinical Evaluation \& Regulatory Strategy**


* Lead the development and maintenance of Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs) in accordance with EU MDR Annex XIV and applicable MEDDEV guidance.
* Develop comprehensive clinical evidence strategies for Class III cardiac ablation catheters and generators.
* Interpret and apply EU MDR clinical requirements to support product development, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle management activities.
* Provide strategic guidance regarding clinical data requirements, PMS, PMCF and PSUR activities, and benefit\-risk determinations.
* Support interactions with Notified Bodies and Competent Authorities regarding clinical evidence and clinical evaluation requirements.
* Monitor evolving European regulatory expectations, MDCG guidance documents, harmonized standards, and industry best practices.

  


**Clinical Research \& Evidence Generation**


* Design and oversee clinical investigations, registries, observational studies, and post\-market clinical follow\-up (PMCF) programs.
* Conduct systematic literature reviews and clinical data analyses to support regulatory submissions and clinical evaluations.
* Evaluate scientific literature, adverse event data, complaint trends, and post\-market surveillance information to establish device safety and performance.
* Lead clinical evidence gap assessments and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Develop Clinical Evaluation Plans (CEPs), PMS, PMCF Plans, PMCF Evaluation Reports, PSURs and Summary of Safety and Clinical Performance (SSCP) documentation.

  


**Data Analysis \& Scientific Leadership**


* Perform advanced analyses of clinical and post\-market data to support safety, efficacy, and performance claims.
* Provide statistical interpretation and scientific rationale for clinical conclusions and regulatory positions.
* Critically evaluate competitor and predicate device clinical evidence to support strategic regulatory initiatives.
* Present clinical findings and recommendations to executive leadership, regulatory bodies, and cross\-functional teams.

  


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support CE Mark submissions, significant change assessments, and product renewals.
* Collaborate with Quality teams to ensure alignment between clinical evidence and risk management documentation.
* Support Engineering teams by providing clinical input during product development and design validation activities.

  


**Your Profile**


**Education Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Public Health, Clinical Research, or related field.
* Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

  


**Experience** **Requirements**


* Minimum 7\+ years of progressive experience in Clinical Affairs, Clinical Research, Medical Writing, or Regulatory Affairs within the medical device industry.
* Significant experience supporting Class III medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated experience authoring and maintaining Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs) under EU MDR.
* Proven experience supporting Notified Body submissions and clinical evidence reviews.
* Experience developing PMS, PMCF Plans and creating PSURs.
* Experience designing or supporting clinical investigations and PMCF studies.

  


**Technical Expertise**



Deep working knowledge of:


* EU MDR 2017/745
* MDR Annex XIV (Clinical Evaluation and PMCF)
* MDR Annex II and Annex III documentation requirements
* MDCG clinical guidance documents
* ISO 14155 (Clinical Investigation of Medical Devices)
* ISO 14971 (Risk Management)
* Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs)
* Clinical Evaluation Plans (CEPs)
* PMCF Plans and PMCF Evaluation Reports
* PMS Plans and PSURs
* Summary of Safety and Clinical Performance (SSCP)
* Literature review methodologies and evidence appraisal
* Benefit\-risk assessments
* Post\-market surveillance and vigilance requirements

  


**Additional Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**


* Experience with cardiovascular, neurovascular, structural heart, electrophysiology or implantable Class III medical devices.
* Experience working directly with European Notified Bodies.
* Knowledge of global clinical regulatory requirements, including FDA clinical evidence expectations and international regulatory frameworks.
* Statistical analysis experience and familiarity with clinical databases and scientific literature platforms.

  


**Competencies**


* Expert knowledge of EU MDR clinical affairs requirements.
* Strong scientific writing and technical documentation skills.
* Exceptional analytical and critical\-thinking abilities.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills.
* Strategic mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  


**Success Measures**



Within the first 12 months, the Principal Clinical Research Analyst will:


* Create and maintain multiple CER and PMCF deliverables for Class III devices with successful Notified Body acceptance.
* Establish robust clinical evidence strategies aligned with EU MDR requirements. Create PMS Plans, PSURs.
* Identify and mitigate clinical evidence gaps proactively.
* Serve as the organization's recognized SME for EU MDR clinical evaluation and clinical evidence generation.

  


**Physical and Travel Requirements**



The physical demands described within this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile.
* The employee is also required to interact with a computer for extended periods of time and communicate with co\-workers.
* Must be able to work a minimum of 40 hours / week. Minimum to no work\-from\-home opportunity.
* Must be able to work onsite at our Tustin, CA facility. No relocation support will be provided.
* Must be able to travel internationally and domestically, up to 25% of the time for audits, investigator meetings, and regulatory interactions.

  


**Work Location**



This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires working onsite at our Tustin, CA office.

  


**Work Environment**



This position is performed primarily in a professional office environment and requires regular use of a computer, standard office equipment, clinical and regulatory databases, and virtual communication tools. Work involves extended periods of sitting, reading, writing, typing, document review, and participation in meetings, with occasional travel to support audits, investigator meetings, regulatory interactions, or other business needs. The employee is expected to maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable company policies, quality system requirements, and regulatory standards. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive base salary, with a **negotiable performance bonus**.
* Comprehensive benefits package.
* Opportunity to shape regulatory strategy for breakthrough cardiac technologies.
* A collaborative, mission‑driven environment where your expertise has immediate impact.

  



BIOTRONIK EP CRC is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation practices. **The base salary range for this position is $165,000 \- $185,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.** In addition to base salary, BIOTRONIK EP CRC offers a bonus program and comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other perks. Compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, experience, and other factors.

  


Are you interested? Please apply online through our application management system! We are looking forward to welcoming you.

  



Location: Tustin, CA \| Working hours: Full\-time \| Type of contract: Unlimited

**Why this role exists**
