Pacaso created co\-ownership of the second home: all the ownership a family actually uses, in the places they love, without the weight of owning it. The old way is whole ownership, with all of its cost and all of its operating burden for a few weeks of use a year. Moving a family from one to the other is among the most considered decisions they will ever make, and most of that consideration happens between conversations with Sales. Lifecycle marketing is how Pacaso shows up well in that time.



Three audiences make the case. Many people discover Pacaso years before they are ready to buy, and re\-engaging them at the right moment is one of our largest growth levers. Active prospects deserve communication that matches the care of the decision they are weighing. And our Owners, the most credible proof the model works, should hear from us with the same taste as the homes they own. This is demand Pacaso has already earned. The job is to convert it.


**IN BRIEF** Own how Pacaso communicates with everyone in our database, from first inquiry through years of ownership.


**What you'll own**
===================



You will shape lifecycle strategy with the VP of Marketing and build it yourself. Together you will decide how each of these audiences should experience Pacaso over time; you will then open Iterable and make it real. You are the most senior lifecycle practitioner at the company, reporting to the VP of Marketing and working closely with brand, creative, analytics and Sales.



Marketing at Pacaso runs lean and AI\-native. We hire owners who multiply themselves with AI rather than teams that grow by headcount. You should already work this way, with AI drafting your variants, scoring your segments and checking your campaigns while your own judgment goes to strategy, taste and measurement.


**REACTIVATION**



Many buyers begin this journey long before they are ready. You will decide when and how to re\-engage past inquiries, what would genuinely bring someone back and how a re\-engaged buyer gets handed to Sales cleanly. It is the fastest path this role has to funded volume, and it is where you will start.


**PROSPECT NURTURE**



A Pacaso purchase can take months of consideration. You will design how a prospect experiences those months: what they hear after a first inquiry, how a specific home or market stays present in their thinking and what earns the consultation. Segmentation, personalization and disciplined testing are your instruments. Pacaso does not discount or rush its buyers, so the program earns attention through relevance rather than urgency.


**OWNER COMMUNICATIONS**



Owners are the heart of the brand and the source of our referrals and resales. Working with the owner experience team, you will define what Owners hear from Pacaso and when, from onboarding through arrival moments, home updates and referral programs, and set the governance that keeps those touches coordinated across teams. The standard is that every message an Owner receives feels like it came from the same hand that welcomed them home.


**PLATFORM AND MEASUREMENT**



You own the Iterable instance end to end: data architecture, deliverability, channel setup across email, SMS and push, and the connections to our CRM and data warehouse. You define lifecycle success in numbers (reactivation rate, conversion to consultation, owner engagement and revenue influenced) and report it to leadership monthly.

  


**Who you are**
===============



You have led lifecycle for a considered, high\-value purchase, in real estate, financial services, travel or something similar, and you never stopped building.



Specifically:


* 8\+ years in lifecycle, CRM or retention marketing, with several of them owning the strategy.
* Expert in Iterable.
* Journeys, segmentation, catalogs, templating and deliverability are muscle memory.
* AI\-native in practice. You can point to programs where AI changed your speed or your results.
* Comfortable in SQL and fluent in funnel math, incrementality and holdout design.
* A writer's ear. You can draft a subject line that converts and catch a line that reads off voice for a brand built on restraint.
* Experienced working with Sales on lead scoring, handoff and pipeline reporting.


**Compensation \- $160,000 to $175,000 depending on experience and location plus equity**

**Why You'll Love Working Here**
--------------------------------



We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.


* **Competitive base salary and meaningful equity** — every Crew member shares in what we're building
* **Discretionary time off** — take the rest you need, when you need it
* **Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage** for you and your family
* **Sponsored memberships** to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole\-person, modern healthcare
* **401(k)** to help you build long\-term security
* **Paid parental leave** for primary and secondary caregivers
* **Home office stipend** and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work
* **Quarterly team gatherings** and ongoing learning and development investment

**Our Commitment**
------------------



Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
description:
**Who We Are**


Robert Half, one of FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For is hiring for a **Senior** **Content Marketing Manager** to join the Marketing department.


The Senior Content Marketing Manager reports to the Director, Content Marketing and serves as a seasoned, senior individual contributor responsible for developing and executing content marketing strategies, programs, and assets that drive audience engagement, consideration, demand, conversion, and retention across Robert Half’s priority hiring manager and job candidate audiences. This role brings deep content marketing specialization, strong judgment, and the ability to resolve a wide range of complex content marketing challenges in creative, performance\-oriented ways.


This role works independently on complex content marketing initiatives, normally receiving little instruction on day\-to\-day work and general instruction on new assignments. Working closely with Integrated Marketing, Brand Marketing, Brand Design Studio, Performance Marketing, Analytics, Web, and Communications teams, the Senior Content Marketing Manager develops audience\-focused content marketing programs that help customers discover, understand, engage with, and take action on Robert Half’s services through traditional search, AI\-powered discovery experiences, landing pages, email, and other marketing experiences.

**What You'll Do**


Content Marketing Strategy, Audience Planning \& Content Marketing Expertise

* Develop audience\-focused content marketing strategies aligned to integrated marketing plans, business priorities, audience needs, and growth objectives.
* Lead the most complex and strategically significant content marketing initiatives supporting enterprise priorities, major integrated marketing programs, and high\-value audience growth opportunities.
* Identify content marketing opportunities based on search behavior, audience insights, market trends, seasonal demand drivers, campaign priorities, and performance data.
* Lead development of content marketing roadmaps that support awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, and content marketing reuse across channels.
* Serve as a senior subject matter expert on content marketing strategy, SEO, AEO, content architecture, search intent, and AI\-discovery best practices.
* Partner with Integrated Marketing Managers to translate audience growth strategies into content marketing programs, priorities, and requirements.
* Partner with Communications to activate thought leadership for marketing use cases while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between content marketing and editorial, reputation, or executive visibility work.
* **What success looks like:** Content marketing priorities are tightly aligned to audience needs, business objectives, search opportunities, and integrated marketing plans.


Content Marketing Development, Writing, Editing \& Optimization

* Develop, write, edit, and optimize complex content marketing assets across channels and formats, including SEO content, AEO content, service pages, landing pages, email nurture programs, FAQ content, and campaign content.
* Lead complex content marketing initiatives where analysis of diverse inputs, audience needs, performance data, and business requirements is needed to determine the best approach.
* Translate complex business topics into clear, useful, audience\-centered content marketing assets that support engagement, consideration, and conversion.
* Ensure content marketing assets reflect brand standards, messaging frameworks, audience insights, search intent, and business priorities.
* Provide content marketing review and quality assurance for high\-impact content marketing assets developed by internal and external contributors.

* **What success looks like:** Content marketing assets are high quality, audience\-focused, discoverable, brand\-aligned, and effective at driving engagement and conversion.


SEO, AEO, Performance \& Continuous Improvement

* Apply advanced SEO and AEO content marketing practices to improve discoverability across traditional search engines and AI\-powered discovery experiences.
* Use judgment to select the appropriate content marketing methods, formats, structures, calls to action, and optimization techniques for each assignment.
* Evaluate content marketing performance and identify opportunities to improve search visibility, AI answer readiness, audience engagement, conversion, and reuse.
* Partner with Analytics, Web, Performance Marketing, and Digital Marketing teams to evaluate performance data and improve content marketing effectiveness.
* Conduct content marketing audits and develop recommendations for refresh, consolidation, reuse, retirement, and optimization.
* Leverage AI\-enabled content marketing workflows and tools to improve speed, quality, consistency, and scale while maintaining accuracy and brand standards.
* Informally mentor and coach Content Marketing Managers and Content Marketing Writers by sharing expertise and helping elevate overall team capabilities.
* **What success looks like:** Content marketing performance improves through optimization, testing, refreshes, reuse, and data\-driven decision making.


Success Measures

* Organic search visibility and content marketing discoverability.
* AEO visibility and readiness for AI\-powered discovery experiences.
* Content marketing engagement and conversion performance.
* Content marketing contribution to demand generation, pipeline, and revenue.
* Content marketing quality, effectiveness, reuse, and scalability.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption of content marketing strategy recommendations.

**What You'll Need**

* BA in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Business, or related field.
* 7\-10 years of progressive experience in content marketing, digital marketing content, marketing communications, copywriting, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated success developing content marketing strategies and content marketing assets that support demand generation, engagement, conversion, and business growth.
* Deep experience creating and optimizing SEO\-focused content marketing assets for digital channels.
* Strong understanding of AEO principles and how content marketing is discovered, summarized, cited, and surfaced in AI\-powered environments.
* Experience leading complex content marketing initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, channels, data inputs, and business considerations.
* Experience working as a senior individual contributor who operates independently with limited day\-to\-day instruction.


Preferred

* Experience in B2B, B2C, professional services, staffing, consulting, technology, or complex business environments.
* Experience using AI\-assisted content marketing tools and workflows responsibly and effectively.
* Experience partnering with integrated marketing, brand, web, analytics, SEO, paid media, and email marketing teams.


Competencies/Abilities

* Content marketing strategy and planning.
* Content marketing architecture and roadmap development.
* Content marketing development, writing, and editing.
* SEO and AEO expertise.
* Audience\-centric content marketing development.
* Search intent strategy and AI\-discovery readiness.
* Content marketing performance optimization.
* Complex problem solving and sound judgment.
* Advanced stakeholder influence and consultation.
* Content marketing leadership without direct authority.
* Mentoring and content marketing capability development.
* Ability to work independently on complex assignments with minimal day\-to\-day instruction.


Interpersonal Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Ability to network with senior internal and external partners within own area of expertise.
* Strong collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex topics and create alignment across cross\-functional partners.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.


Minimum Required Technical Skills

* Content management systems.
* SEO and keyword research tools.
* Marketing analytics and reporting tools.
* Microsoft Office Suite and Copilot.
* AI\-assisted content marketing creation and optimization tools.
* Familiarity with web publishing and content marketing optimization workflows.

We offer exceptional earning potential and a competitive benefits package, including group health insurance benefits (medical, vision, dental), FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave of up to 6 weeks, and short/long term disability. title: Brand Systems Director, AI
description:
**Company Description**  

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full\-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next\-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.


We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.


We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

 **Job Description**  

The Brand Operations Director, AI is a hybrid creative and operational leader responsible for both how the EVERSANA AI Agency platform is positioned and brought to market and how it is applied to deliver real, measurable value for clients. This is a bridge role — connecting brand and go\-to\-market strategy with platform\-enabled creative execution — and requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping the narrative around the platform and guiding its application within live client engagements.


This role partners closely with Strategy, Account, Product, and Creative teams to ensure the platform is used in ways that are strategically sharp, creatively strong, and commercially differentiated. The right candidate brings deep experience in brand systems, growth\-oriented creative, and integrated campaigns, and is energized by the challenge of translating complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling client value.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

**Client\-Facing Platform Application \& Creative Operations**


Guide the application of the AIA Platform within active client engagements, ensuring creative output is strategically grounded and operationally efficient:

* Define and shape creative briefs that translate client business objectives into platform\-enabled creative solutions
* Pitch and present AI\-powered creative concepts to clients in partnership with Strategy and Account leads
* Supervise and quality\-control AI\-enabled creative output, maintaining high standards across pharma brand, HCP, DTP, and payer audiences
* Partner with creative teams (whether sole\-operator or small pod model) to build modular, scalable creative systems
* Identify gaps between platform capability and client need, feeding structured insight back to Product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into sharp, resonant positioning and messaging
* Leads multidisciplinary creative teams with clarity, high standards, and strong velocity
* Connects brand narrative to pipeline, sales enablement, and commercial performance
* Comfortable operating in both strategic definition and hands\-on execution modes

title: E-Commerce Director (Consumer Division)
description:
The E\-Commerce Director will lead digital commerce across its consumer brand portfolio (6 brands within a single product category family). This position owns the overall ecommerce strategy and P\&L performance across each brand's Shopify direct\-to\-consumer store, Amazon (FBA and FBM), and all secondary sales channels, including Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy, Google Shopping, Facebook/Instagram Shop, YouTube, and other emerging marketplaces.


This is a strategic leadership role, not a hands\-on execution role. The Ecommerce Director will not, on a daily basis, personally execute campaigns, design creative, or manage listings, but must bring deep, current expertise across paid advertising, content creation, digital marketing, email/SMS campaigns, affiliate marketing, SEO/GEO, and web design/UX in order to set direction, evaluate performance, coach staff, and hold the team accountable to results.


The Ecommerce Director will partner closely with the Brand Managers to build, drive, and execute strategies that accelerate profitable growth, and will direct the shared services team to bring those strategies to life.

**Essential Job Functions:**


Strategic Leadership \& Team Management \-

* Set the overall ecommerce vision, strategy, and annual growth plan for all six consumer brands across Shopify, Amazon, and secondary channels.
* Directly manage, coach, and develop 3 Brand Managers, setting clear goals, KPIs, and accountability standards for each brand under their purview.
* Directly manage the shared services team – Web Developer, Ecommerce Ad Manager, Amazon Ad Manager, and SEO/GEO Specialist – functioning as an internal agency that services all brands; set priorities, resolve resourcing conflicts, and ensure work is allocated effectively across brands based on strategic priority.
* Co\-create and drive c
* hannel and brand\-level strategies in close partnership with Brand Managers, translating division\-wide priorities into brand\-specific execution plans that the shared services team then executes against.
* Establish intake, prioritization, and workflow processes so Brand Managers can effectively request and receive support from the shared web, ad, and SEO/GEO functions without bottlenecks or conflicting priorities.
* Build a high\-performing ecommerce organization across both the Brand Manager and shared services layers; identify skill gaps and advocate for additional resources, agencies, or tools as needed.
* Own the ecommerce budget and revenue targets across the division; report performance, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Foster cross\-brand collaboration to share best practices, creative learnings, and efficiencies across all six consumer brands in the portfolio.


Markeplace \& Channel Strategy –

* Oversee strategy and performance across each brand's Shopify storefront, ensuring strong conversion rates, site health, and customer experience, directing the Web Developer's priorities accordingly.
* Direct Amazon strategy across both FBA and FBM models – including account health, inventory strategy, Buy Box performance, and marketplace compliance – in partnership with the Amazon Ad Manager and Brand Managers.
* Guide expansion and optimization of secondary channels including Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy, Google Shopping/Merchant Center, Facebook/Instagram Shop, YouTube Shopping, and other relevant marketplaces.
* Evaluate and prioritize new sales channel opportunities based on ROI, brand fit, and resourcing.


Paid Media \& Ad Spend –

* Set overarching paid media strategy and budget allocation across Amazon Ads, Google Ads/Shopping, Meta Ads, and YouTube, directing the Ecommerce Ad Manager and Amazon Ad Manager on efficient allocation of spend across all brands.
* Establish and monitor KPIs such as ROAS, TACoS/ACoS, CAC, and LTV; hold the ad management team and Brand Managers accountable to targets.
* Evaluate agency and platform partners that supplement the internal ad management team; approve major shifts in ad strategy or budget.


Content, Digital Marketing \& Email/Affiliate Programs –

* Direct content strategy (product photography, video, A\+ Content/Enhanced Brand Content, lifestyle content) ensuring brand consistency and conversion\-focused execution across all six brands.
* Guide digital marketing strategy including email/SMS lifecycle campaigns, promotional calendars, and customer retention programs.
* Oversee development and growth of affiliate and influencer marketing programs across brands.
* Direct the SEO/GEO Specialist's strategy and roadmap to maximize organic visibility across traditional search and AI\-driven search/answer engines, ensuring consistent execution across all brand sites.


Web Design \& User Experience

* Direct the Web Developer's priorities and roadmap across all Shopify storefronts, balancing competing requests from the various Brand Managers.
* Ensure a consistent, high\-quality, mobile\-optimized customer experience and strong CRO discipline across all brand sites and marketplace storefronts.


Analytics \& Reporting

* Establish division\-wide reporting standards and dashboards for sales, ad spend, marketplace, and channel performance, pulling from the Brand Managers and shared services specialists.
* Analyze performance trends across brands and channels to identify growth opportunities, risks, and areas needing intervention.
* Present regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

**Physical Demands:**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Must be able to sit at a desk for prolonged periods of time and work on a computer.
* Must be able to work in an office environment.
* Must be able to talk, hear and see with vision abilities including close/near, distance, color and peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Must wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when entering manufacturing areas.

**Education and Experience:**


Required –

* 7\+ years of progressive ecommerce experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing a team, a multi\-brand or multi\-channel portfolio, and/or a shared\-services/agency\-style function.
* Proven, demonstrable expertise across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central/Vendor Central (both FBA and FBM), and secondary marketplaces (Walmart.com, eBay, Etsy).
* Strong working knowledge of paid advertising across Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and YouTube, including budget strategy and performance evaluation, sufficient to direct and evaluate specialist ad managers.
* Deep familiarity with digital marketing disciplines: content strategy, email/SMS marketing, affiliate/influencer marketing, SEO, and emerging GEO/AI\-search optimization practices.
* Working knowledge of web design, UX principles, and conversion rate optimization best practices, sufficient to direct a web developer and evaluate their output.
* Experience managing a shared\-services or “internal agency” model, balancing and prioritizing competing requests from multiple internal stakeholders.
* Track record of setting strategy and managing performance through others rather than personally executing tactical work.
* Strong analytical skills; fluency with ecommerce analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics, Amazon Brand Analytics, etc.) and ability to translate data into strategy.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred –

* Experience in building products, home improvement, industrial, or specialty/DIY consumer goods categories.
* Experience managing multiple distinct brands or business units simultaneously through a shared team structure.
* Familiarity with specialty coatings, resins, or adjacent DIY/trade product categories.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA a plus.

***What Success Looks Like:***

* Consistent, profitable revenue growth across all brands, channels, and marketplaces within the division.
* A well\-coached, accountable team of Brand Managers executing clear, data\-driven strategies, supported by a high\-functioning internal shared services team.
* Efficient, optimized ad spend delivering strong ROAS across all paid channels, with ad managers who are clear on priorities and accountable to results.
* Strong, consistent brand experiences and customer satisfaction across every website and marketplace storefront.
* A shared services model (web, ad, SEO/GEO) that runs smoothly, with clear prioritization and no brand feeling under\-served.
* Reliable, transparent reporting that gives executive leadership clear visibility into performance and growth opportunities.

***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.***

title: Director of Communications & Marketing - Evinova
description:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R\-259734 **Date posted** 08/09/2026
  
**EVINOVA \- DIRECTOR OF MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS**


POSITION SUMMARY


The Director of Marketing and Communications is responsible for developing and delivering Evinova’s marketing strategy and strengthening the company’s position as a differentiated digital health partner to the clinical trials industry. This individual will translate Evinova’s AI\-enabled platform—including the Unified Trial Solution (UTS), Remote Patient Monitoring, Study Design \& Optimization, Portfolio Management, and Digital Strategy Consulting—together with AstraZeneca’s heritage, into clear market positioning that builds credibility with clinical trial teams, sponsors, and life sciences partners across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.


The Director will work closely with Commercial Leadership, Product, Solutions, Clinical Operations, and other subject\-matter experts across Evinova. This is a hands\-on leadership role for an experienced life sciences or health technology marketer who can set strategy while personally driving execution in a fast\-growing, regulated commercial environment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Market Positioning and Brand Strategy


* Define differentiated positioning that communicates Evinova’s patient\-centered approach, enterprise scale, and core capabilities, including the Unified Trial Solution, Remote Patient Monitoring, ePRO/eCOA integration, Study Design \& Optimization, Portfolio Management, and partner interoperability.

Content, Thought Leadership, and Communications


* Lead content and communications across case studies, thought leadership, presentations, webinars, conferences, press, web, and social media channels, Translating clinical and platform results into credible proof points.
* Manage external agencies and content partners as needed.

Commercial and Sales Enablement


* Partner with Commercial and Business Development teams to support pipeline generation and strategic opportunities.

Digital Marketing and Demand Generation


* Own the website, content management system, marketing automation, LinkedIn presence, and targeted digital campaigns.

Conferences and Industry Presence


* Develop a commercially focused conference strategy that prioritizes relevant events, sponsorships, speaking opportunities, executive thought leadership, targeted customer engagement, and supporting outreach and follow\-up.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


**Experience**


* 8\+ or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience.
* Substantial experience in clinical trial technology, digital health, life sciences services, or a closely related sector.

**Industry Knowledge**


* Strong understanding of the clinical research ecosystem.
* Knowledge of how pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and other life sciences sponsors evaluate and select digital trial and clinical technology partners.

**Clinical Trial Technology Experience**


* Direct experience marketing digital trial platforms, remote patient monitoring solutions, or clinical trial data and analytics solutions is strongly preferred.
* Experience working closely with commercial organizations in the clinical trial technology sector is also advantageous.

**Commercial Orientation**


* Demonstrated ability to build marketing programs and content that support business development, pipeline generation, and revenue growth—not solely brand awareness.

**Positioning and Messaging**


* Proven ability to translate complex clinical, product, and technology capabilities into clear, differentiated, and credible market positioning.

**Content Development**


* Excellent writing and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated experience developing executive\-level presentations, case studies, website content, thought leadership materials, and sales collateral.

**Digital Marketing**


* Experience with digital marketing, customer relationship management (CRM), marketing automation, website and content management systems, analytics, social media, and targeted demand\-generation programs.

**Clinical Fluency**


* Sufficient knowledge of clinical trials and clinical operations to work effectively with clinical experts.

**Education**


* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Advanced degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or a related field is a plus.

**Communication**


* Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executives, clinical experts, commercial teams, sponsors, and external partners.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life\-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


The annual base pay for this position ranges from $146,717\.00 \- $220,075\.00 USD Annual. Hourly and salaried non\-exempt employees will also be paid overtime pay when working qualifying overtime hours. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. description:
**About Amplify**


Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high\-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit Amplify.com.

**Job Description:**


Amplify is a pioneer in K–12 education, partnering with educators to make learning rigorous and riveting for every student through next\-generation curriculum and assessment. Our captivating core and supplemental programs in ELA, math, and science engage all students in rigorous learning and inspire them to think deeply, creatively, and for themselves. Today, Amplify serves over fifteen million students in all 50 states.


As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead cross\-functional teams of writers, designers, interaction developers, learning scientists, and marketers to dream up, design, and deliver transformative classroom experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Define the north star** \- set the vision, strategy, and 12–18 month roadmap for the curriculum that aligns with the company’s long\-term goals and product strategy while solving immediate customer pain points and contribute insights that shape the 2\-3 year company’s product portfolio vision
* **Deliver business impact** \- set quarterly OKRs for your product area in partnership with GPM/Director; hold yourself and team accountable for product\-level outcomes. Monitor performance metrics and implement review cycles to ensure features drive customer retention, engagement, and revenue, and team success. Drive products through the stage gate process, owning deliverables and analysis for your product area. Partner with GPM on cross\-product investment decisions.
* **Participate in planning** \- own and execute research initiatives, develop product concepts and plans to deliver business goals, create detailed release/execution quarterly plans with feature/task estimates in partnership with cross\-functional team
* **Partner with Supply Chain** \- collaborate with Supply Chain to define physical components and product specifications (e.g., binding types, paper weight, durability), balancing classroom performance/durability expectations, instructional quality standards, and brand and safety requirements, while achieving margin targets
* **Be obsessed with your customers** \- passionately advocate for your users in all phases of product development. Conduct qualitative research (interviews, focus groups, observations) and quantitative analysis to deeply understand user needs and translate them into product priorities.
* **Leverage market intelligence** \- continuously analyze competitor curriculum offerings to identify gaps, differentiators, and winning features for the next edition/release. Observe industry trends and incorporate findings into future plans driving competitive advantage and differentiation.
* **Own end\-to\-end product delivery** \- lead products and the teams that create and enable them from ideation and requirement gathering to launch and post\-launch iteration. Be ultimately accountable for product quality and scope, product and organizational readiness, PD strategy, and delivery timeline.
* **Lead product execution** \- lead ceremonies for multiple teams. Attend daily stand ups and work with APM/teams to ensure all blockers are resolved within 24 hours. Clearly provide broader context and goals to cross\-functional teams for sprint plans and features.
* **Harness strategic influence** \- lead by influence, not authority. Align senior leadership and stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, CX) around your product vision, strategy and roadmap, and be the organization’s “go to” person for your products and features.
* **Enable go\-to\-market success** \- partner with Marketing, Sales and CX to develop positioning, internal training, and external messaging that ensures a successful product launch and market performance.

**How you work…**

* You embrace innovation \- identifying and prioritizing AI opportunities across your product area, shaping the roadmap leveraging AI capabilities like personalization, automation, and prediction to unlock new value for users and your teams. Partner with engineering to evaluate feasibility and bring AI experiences to market.
* You communicate with confidence \- representing the details of your product/features to your team and senior leaders alike.
* You promote a culture of excellence \- driving a high\-performance team culture characterized by speed, curiosity, honesty, continuous improvement, and a focus on outcomes over outputs.
* You focus on student and teacher outcomes over output \- ensuring all product decisions ladder up to real\-world value, scale effectively, and advance Amplify’s mission.
* You are a master at creative problem solving \- leaning into constraints and utilizing them to drive realistic solutions, not bogged down by them as limitations.
* You leverage data for decisions \- partnering with Research \& Measurement and Data Science to measure and evaluate hypotheses and releases, and extracting associated insights to inform your product strategy and team.
* You are a natural mentor \- eager to share your expertise of product management with APMs and PMs to support their development.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of product management experience, ideally in a high\-growth SaaS, ed tech, or consumer tech environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in related field required or combination of education and direct experience. Advanced degree preferred.
* Startup and growth experience \- you’ve thrived in fast\-moving environments where priorities shift and ownership is essential.
* Proven track record of delivery \- you’ve managed the end\-to\-end lifecycle of complex products, from vision through launch and iteration.
* A team leader \- you inspire teammates, put structure around ambiguity, and align diverse stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills \- you’re a great storyteller in words and writing. You can simplify complex concepts for diverse stakeholders and inspire confidence in leadership.
* AI enthusiasm \- you’re comfortable shaping AI\-powered experiences, partnering with technical teams to evaluate opportunities and bring them to market.
* Technical literacy \- you’re comfortable working with complex technical domains and partnering with engineers to solve hard problems.

 Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 7 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education.  As Head of Education at Platzi, you own the content engine and the team behind it: the Course Directors, the Postproduction Manager (who leads the editors). You own the content strategy end\-to\-end and you keep the whole system running. You report to the CPO.

**\-\-What's Fitune** 




 Fitune is the intelligent operating system for fitness and wellness studios.
 



 Studios across Latin America run their business on complicated software or manual processes. We built Fitune so that running and growing a studio is easier and more profitable: a conversion\-optimised website and app, booking, in\-person classes, events, courses and 1\-on\-1s, automated payments and subscriptions, client and business management, and more.
 



 Fitune launched in 2021 and now serves hundreds of studios processing more than a quarter of a million bookings a month, with a 30\-person team across Mexico, Colombia, Chile and Brazil. We aim to grow past 3,000 studios in 2027\.
 



  





 Our product in action

* On\-demand demo: https://www.fitune.io/watch\-demo
* Our website: www.fitune.io

 We are looking for the on\-camera face of Fitune in Latin America: a senior creator who is active in the fitness world, genuinely energetic, and happiest when they are in a studio talking to the people who run it.
 



 This person owns the relationship between Fitune and the community around it — studio owners, coaches, and the people who train in those studios. They visit to studios, interview owners, film sessions and events, create challenges and activations, and turn all of it into content that studio owners want to watch and share.

 Visit to top studios to interview owners, cover live training sessions and events, and capture testimonials. Create challenges and activations that bring studios and their communities into the Fitune orbit. Build real relationships with partner studios, coaches, and end users — the kind where people text you before they text support.
 



  





**\-\-Premium video production** 




 Own video end to end, from concept to published cut. Short\-form and long\-form, both edited to a standard that matches a premium brand. You are comfortable being the only person on set.
 



  





**\-\-Product representation** 




 Star in and produce product videos that translate technical features into content people actually finish watching. You make software feel useful and human.
 



  





**\-\-Be the face of Fitune Academy** 




 You are the image of Fitune Academy, our educational platform for fitness and wellness studios.  Manage day\-to\-day publishing across Facebook (including Facebook groups like Pilates coaches groups, etc) , Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. This combination of creative and commercial expertise makes TGP an exciting environment for people who are passionate about food, hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences.

  

We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.

**Design Expertise**

* SketchUp
* PowerPoint

* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6

* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team

* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Marketing & Growth Manager

 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.

* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.

 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:

* Campaign execution.

 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.

 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.

* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.

 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.

* Creative agencies.

* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.

 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.

* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.

* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.

* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.

* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

title: Director of Design and Construction
description:
ABOUT ESCAPOLOGY

Escapology is one of the fastest\-growing escape room franchise companies in the world. We create immersive, high\-quality guest experiences — and the physical environments we design and build are the foundation of that promise. As we scale into 2027 and beyond, the way our spaces look, feel, and function matters more than ever.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Director of Design \& Construction who leads with design and executes through construction — in that order. This role is integral to how Escapology spaces come to life, from initial concept through completed build\-out.

The right person has a background in architecture or interior design and has spent meaningful time getting spaces actually built — managing contractors, timelines, and budgets without losing sight of what the finished environment is supposed to feel like. You report directly to the Chief Development Officer and work across corporate locations, franchisee build\-outs, and the ongoing development of Escapology's design standards.

\-\-\-

WHAT YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE TO

Design Direction \& Brand Standards

\- Be influential in shaping the visual, spatial, and experiential standards that define what an Escapology location looks and feels like

\- Develop and maintain a design standards guide covering layout, materials, lighting, theming, and signage — usable by both corporate and franchisee teams

\- Contribute to approved floorplan variants and design packages that allow franchisees to build to brand standard across a range of space types and markets

\- Stay ahead of trends in experiential design and entertainment environments

Corporate Construction Management

\- Manage corporate build\-outs end\-to\-end — permit through punch list — with full accountability for budget, timeline, and quality

\- Coordinate GCs, specialty vendors, and design consultants across simultaneous projects in multiple markets

\- Oversee R\&M for corporate locations in the first year post\-opening

Franchisee Design \& Construction Support

\- Be a go\-to resource for franchisees throughout their build\-out — reviewing plans, providing guidance, and helping ensure brand standards are met

\- Work with the Franchise Development team to ensure franchisees are construction\-ready at the right point in the pipeline

\- Provide input on franchisee space selection from a design and constructability standpoint

Vendor Relationships \& Process Improvement

\- Help build and manage relationships with preferred vendors and contractors — identifying opportunities to improve quality, reduce cost, and shorten timelines

\- Develop and maintain cost benchmarks per location type and market

\-\-\-

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

\- Degree in architecture, interior design, or a related design discipline

\- 5\+ years of experience spanning both design and construction — concept through completion

\- Experience managing multiple construction projects simultaneously across different markets with full budget and timeline accountability

\- Background in hospitality, experiential retail, entertainment, or themed environments strongly preferred

\- Proficiency in design software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, or equivalent) and project management tools

Every guest who walks into an Escapology location is forming an opinion about our brand in the first thirty seconds — before they've played a single game. The role requires a strategic, operational, and execution‑focused leader who is highly motivated and accountable for delivering stable, scalable, and efficient systems that drive enterprise KPIs, including financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, employee experience, and cost optimization. You must operate at both levels: strategically identifying opportunities for modernization, automation, and simplification, while tactically resolving system gaps, process inefficiencies, and business challenges that arise in Finance, HR, and Real Estate operations.

**Role Responsibilities:**

**Strategy \& Planning**

* *Product Strategy \& Roadmap* \- You own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area of focus. Must be able to distill the "fire hose" of insights, data, and requests into an actionable vision inclusive of customer and business partners needs to build both incremental and innovative experiences for your customers, ensuring that value is delivered early, often, and in\-sync with customer goals. You are responsible for prioritizing features to support the enterprise cross\-functional roadmap across all product groups. * *Know Your Business* \- Accountable for results. Whether that is maximizing metrics, managing expectations, addressing customer feedback, or prioritizing the backlog. Knowing your numbers, competitors, who is doing what, the next big thing, suggesting innovative ideas to POC and constantly striving to increase revenue and conversion are primary responsibilities for your role. You will provide regular reporting to executive management along with strategies to constantly improve the numbers, hit revenue goals, and maximize return on investment.
* *Product Decisions* \- you will be called upon to make tough decisions, whether it is a go/no\-go decision, balancing risks versus reward, pros/cons, dependencies, cost/benefit analysis, or ROI of resource investment. You must stand behind your decision with facts and data. Must be able to recognize when to change course and reverse a decision, subscribing to the philosophy of learning fast, and moving on.
* *Budget Management* \- Manage a multimillion\-dollar capital and professional services budget; forecasting and creating business cases for additional funding, vendor selection and staff expansion.

**Delivery \& Execution**

* *Delivery \-* Lead the development and execution of the data and analytics roadmap, inclusive of strategic planning sessions and annual and quarterly planning sessions. In addition to overseeing the implementation and adherence to data governance and data lifecycle management processes.
* *Features \-* Manage and at times create accurate user stories and prioritizes the backlog; working with the team to groom, refine, and ultimately deliver the feature.
* *Partner \-* Be the critical partner across the organization, aligning with key Business stakeholders and roadmaps and KPIs, working with Engineering to ensure that data infrastructure and tools are in place to support data\-driven initiatives and linking with Program and Portfolio team to ensure on\-time, on\-budget delivery against prioritized initiatives.

* *Testing and Research \-* Formulates hypothesis to A/B test, prototype, or research, continually refining the product until desired outcome is achieved. Ensures successful tests are translated into new site features.
* *Vendors \-* Accountable for the management, selection, budget and oversight of a portfolio of 3rd party vendor partners. Regularly holding business reviews, monitoring SLAs, managing RFPs, negotiating contracts and managing budgets for those services.

**People**

* *Change Influencer \-* Acts as an agent of change within your team, organization, and leading to embrace new methodologies, processes, efficiencies and challenging the status quo. Constantly pushing and asking why even if it's to Senior Executives. You must be a strong communicator and partner, capable of influencing a team of designers, developers, stakeholders, and executives to achieve value early and often.
* *Leader \-* Group product managers control the destiny of Products for the organization. You must evangelize your team's services and roadmap; distill complex technical concepts into plain language for stakeholders, and advocate for the customer. Ensuring alignment across your group and the Product organization.
* *Partnering \-* Partners with business and technology stakeholders to define and ensure successful delivery of our consumer and associate facing Commerce experiences. Manages stakeholder expectations and provides education to requestors on prioritization, ROI, and roadmap.
* *Staff Management \-* Lead the team of Product Manager, Designers and Analyst, including setting goals and providing guidance and mentorship

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's Degree
* 7 \- 10 years experience
* 7\+ years of Product leadership, with preference of product management or digital strategy within large cross functional retail environments

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

title: Director, AR Strategy, Analytics & Operations
description:
**At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen.**  

  

Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work.  

  

Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life. We are a team of **Innovators, Collaborators and Doers.**  

  

We’re seeking a **Director, AR Strategy, Analytics \& Operations** to join us. This is a remote position.  

  

In this hands\-on leadership role, you will turn complex accounts receivable questions into data\-backed operational action. You’ll investigate large datasets, identify root causes, recommend solutions, communicate with clients and senior leaders, and drive agreed\-upon actions through completion.  

  

This role blends analytics, healthcare revenue cycle operations, project execution, and client communication. It may initially have limited or no direct reports, so success requires strong independent ownership and the ability to influence outcomes across teams.  

  

**What you’ll do:*** Own complex AR investigations and selected operational functions from initial question through resolution and ongoing monitoring.
* Query and analyze large datasets to identify AR, denial, claim rejection, reimbursement, payer, and workflow trends.
* Determine root causes by connecting data findings to operational processes, then translate findings into practical action plans.
* Write and modify SQL queries used for operational analysis and performance monitoring.
* Prepare client\-specific AR performance reviews and concise executive\-level summaries of complex issues.
* Participate in and lead selected internal, client, payer, and executive meetings on behalf of AR leadership.
* Coordinate solutions across AR, EDI, Coding, Client Relationship Management, technology, and other operational teams.
* Develop recurring monitoring to confirm that corrective actions are effective and issues remain resolved.
* Identify opportunities to automate workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve AR performance.

**What you’ll bring to Zotec:*** Healthcare revenue cycle management experience, ideally within professional billing or physician revenue cycle operations.
* Strong knowledge of accounts receivable, denial management, claims processing, payer behavior, and reimbursement.
* Demonstrated success analyzing large or complex operational and financial datasets and identifying meaningful root causes.
* An operational mindset and a track record of translating analysis into measurable process or performance improvements.
* Working proficiency in SQL, with the ability to independently access and query data, is strongly preferred.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor complex findings for frontline teams, technical partners, clients, and executives.
* Independent judgment and ownership, including the ability to move forward with limited structure once an objective is established.
* Ability to influence without relying on formal authority and to coordinate work across departments.
* Strong project execution skills and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
* Comfort challenging assumptions when the available evidence points in a different direction.

**Additional experience that’s valuable:*** Experience supporting hospital\-based physician specialties such as Emergency Medicine, Radiology, or Anesthesia.
* Experience with payer reimbursement, claims adjudication, workflow design, or automation.
* Experience partnering with technical, product, or development teams.
* Client\-facing revenue cycle experience and cross\-functional project leadership.
* Experience working with outsourced or offshore operational teams or leading people.


At Zotec, you will enjoy a network of highly experienced professionals in an environment where you can operate with autonomy yet have the resources and backing of other professionals in a similar role. Entrepreneurial and enterprising is the spirit of our team. If you are an original thinker and opportunity seeker, we'd like to talk to you!  

  

Learn more about our organization, by visiting us at www.zotecpartners.com

###### **Senior Account Director \- Global Events Agency**

###### **Location: US \| Remote \| International travel required**
**Salary: $155,000–$175,000 \+ bonus**

###### **About Nteractive**


At **Nteractive**, we design and deliver world\-class experiential, event, and conference solutions that connect brands with people in powerful, meaningful ways.


We partner with some of the world’s most influential organizations to create large\-scale, high\-impact global programs — from flagship conferences and destination events to complex, multi\-market activations. Our work blends strategy, creativity, technology, and flawless delivery to produce experiences that truly move audiences.


Our success is built on our people. We are a collaborative, ambitious, and values\-driven agency that invests in talent, encourages innovation, and empowers our teams to take ownership and make a real difference. We believe in long\-term partnerships, exceptional client service, and continuously raising the bar in everything we do.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an exceptional **Senior Account Director** to lead one of Nteractive’s confidential flagship global accounts.

###### **The Role**


This is a high\-profile senior leadership role for an experienced **event agency client leader** who knows how to operate at significant scale.


As the senior client owner, you’ll be responsible for the strategic direction, commercial performance, growth and overall health of a major global account, working across complex programmes with **event budgets ranging from $40M–$70M**.


You’ll be a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, while also providing strong leadership internally — aligning Client Services, Project Leadership, Creative, Production, Event Services and our wider agency teams around a shared vision and consistently exceptional delivery.


We’re looking for someone with **gravitas, presence and agility** — a strategic and commercially minded leader who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate confidently, manage significant budgets and bring people with them.


This is an opportunity for a true agency superstar to have significant influence across a major global partnership and help shape the next phase of its growth.

###### **What you'll be doing**

##### **Client Leadership \& Strategic Partnership**

* Serve as the senior executive lead and primary client owner for a confidential flagship account.
* Build trusted, long\-term relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a strategic advisor across their global event and conference portfolio.
* Set the strategic direction for the account, ensuring Nteractive’s capabilities and resources are aligned to the client’s evolving business objectives.
* Understand the client’s organisation, priorities and challenges deeply, identifying opportunities where Nteractive can create additional value.
* Represent the voice of the client internally at executive level, ensuring their needs and expectations are understood across the agency.
* Challenge thinking constructively and bring strategic recommendations that improve outcomes and strengthen the partnership.

##### **Account Growth \& Commercial Leadership**

* Own the growth strategy for the account, identifying opportunities to expand Nteractive’s involvement, service lines and strategic influence.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing and senior agency leadership on growth initiatives, pitches and RFPs.
* Identify opportunities across destination conferences, corporate events and other strategic programmes.
* Own the financial performance of the account, ensuring strong profitability across all engagements.
* Develop and oversee **large\-scale event and programme budgets of $40M–$70M**, ensuring financial performance is closely monitored and managed.
* Identify opportunities to improve commercial performance, value creation and long\-term account growth.
* Lead commercial negotiations with clients and partners, balancing client objectives with Nteractive’s commercial interests.

##### **Internal Agency Leadership**

* Lead and inspire the senior internal team supporting the account, creating clarity, accountability and a high\-performance culture.
* Build strong relationships with internal agency stakeholders and ensure seamless collaboration across departments.
* Work closely with Project Leadership and senior functional leaders to establish governance, organisational structures and ways of working that enable the account to scale effectively.
* Align Nteractive’s organisational structure with the client’s own teams and operating model to support rapid growth and consistently high\-quality delivery.
* Collaborate with the executive team and department heads to ensure the right resources, expertise and capabilities are deployed at the right time.
* Mentor, coach and develop team members, creating opportunities for growth and ensuring people feel empowered to succeed.

##### **Event \& Programme Leadership**

* Provide senior oversight across major global programmes, ensuring projects and events are delivered to the highest standards.
* Act as the senior Nteractive representative onsite for key events, managing client expectations and resolving escalated issues with confidence.
* Maintain a clear view across multiple concurrent projects, risks, priorities and dependencies.
* Ensure delivery remains aligned to client objectives, agreed scope, timelines, quality standards and budgets.
* Bring calm, decisive leadership to complex and fast\-moving situations.

##### **Governance, Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain best\-in\-class account governance, ensuring clear ownership, communication and accountability.
* Gather and act on client feedback to continuously improve Nteractive’s services and strengthen the partnership.
* Identify emerging trends, capabilities and opportunities that can enhance the client experience.
* Share learning and best practice across Nteractive, helping strengthen Client Services capability across the wider agency.
* Build and maintain a strong network of industry talent, helping Nteractive attract and retain the people required to support account growth.

###### **What you will bring**


We’re looking for a **proven senior agency leader** who has operated at significant scale and understands what it takes to lead complex global event programmes and high\-value client relationships.


You’ll ideally bring:

* Significant senior\-level experience within an **events, experiential, brand experience or creative agency**.
* A strong track record of leading **large\-scale events and programmes with $40M–$70M budgets**.
* Proven experience owning major client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Strong internal agency stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align and influence multiple departments and senior leaders.
* Excellent strategic thinking, with the ability to connect client objectives to commercial and experiential solutions.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including significant budget ownership, forecasting and profitability management.
* Excellent negotiation and influencing skills, with the confidence to manage complex commercial conversations.
* A proven track record of identifying and delivering account growth opportunities.

* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the gravitas and presence to operate confidently at executive level.
* High emotional intelligence, diplomacy and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
* Agility and resilience — someone who can adapt quickly, make decisions and remain composed under pressure.
* A growth mindset and genuine passion for delivering exceptional client experiences.

###### **Why you'll love working here**

* Lead one of Nteractive’s most significant global client partnerships.
* Work on complex, high\-profile programmes with **$40M–$70M event budgets**.
* Partner directly with senior executives at leading global organisations.
* Have significant influence over account strategy, growth and commercial performance.
